seinfeld.description: George is charmed by Elaine's new boyfriend; Kramer thinks Jerry's new girlfriend is his phone-sex mate.

seinfeld.title: The Dinner Party
seinfeld.description: A "brief" stop to buy gifts for a dinner party becomes an ordeal thanks to George's big coat.

seinfeld.title: The Marine Biologist
seinfeld.description: A writer hits a woman in the head with Elaine's electronic organiser; George lies to impress a woman.

seinfeld.title: The Pie
seinfeld.description: A mannequin resembles Elaine; George battles for a bargain suit; Jerry wonders why his date won't try a pie; Kramer has an itch.

seinfeld.title: The Stand-In
seinfeld.description: George postpones breaking up with his girlfriend; Kramer befriends a fellow soap-opera stand-in; and Jerry bombs trying to cheer up a sick friend.

seinfeld.title: The Wife
seinfeld.description: Jerry's girlfriend poses as his wife to get in on his dry-cleaning discount.

seinfeld.title: The Raincoats (1)
seinfeld.description: Kramer plans to profit from raincoats created by Jerry's dad; George sells his dad's old "cruisewear."

seinfeld.title: The Raincoats (2)
seinfeld.description: The sale of Morty's raincoats is delayed; George tries to buy back his dad's clothes.

seinfeld.title: The Fire
seinfeld.description: George embarrasses himself at a kids' birthday party; Jerry heckles back at a heckler.

seinfeld.title: The Hamptons
seinfeld.description: In the Hamptons, George's date sunbathes topless; Kramer steals lobsters; and a handsome doctor compliments Elaine, or does he?

seinfeld.title: The Opposite
seinfeld.description: George changes his life by going against his instincts; Kramer plugs his book on "Live with Regis and Kathie Lee."

seinfeld.title: The Chaperone
seinfeld.description: Kramer supervises Jerry's date with a Miss America contestant; George gets the Yankees to wear cotton; Elaine tries to fill the shoes of a late book editor.

seinfeld.title: The Big Salad
seinfeld.description: Kramer fears a golf dispute has pushed his opponent to murder; Jerry dates a woman whom Newman rejected.

seinfeld.title: The Pledge Drive
seinfeld.description: Elaine mistakes a man for a woman on the phone; George gets baseball's Danny Tartabull to join Jerry at a fund-raiser.

seinfeld.title: The Chinese Woman
seinfeld.description: Jerry makes a blind date; Kramer makes a change to increase his sperm count.

seinfeld.title: The Couch
seinfeld.description: Freedom-of-choice issues disrupt Elaine's new relationship and Kramer's business; George watches a video instead of reading his book-club book.

seinfeld.title: The Gymnast
seinfeld.description: His girl's mom sees George as a bum; Kramer encourages Jerry to make the most of dating a gymnast; 3-D art mesmerizes Mr. Pitt.

seinfeld.title: The Soup
seinfeld.description: Jerry pays dearly for a "free" suit from a comic; Elaine has a beau who's no gentleman; George's way with words ends his relationship with a waitress.

seinfeld.title: The Mom & Pop Store
seinfeld.description: George buys a car thinking it was owned by Jon Voight; Kramer tries to save a mom-and-pop store; Elaine gets her boss into the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

seinfeld.title: The Secretary
seinfeld.description: Clothing problems are a hang-up; George hires a secretary.

seinfeld.title: The Race
seinfeld.description: Jerry dates a woman whose boss has a grudge against him; Elaine dates a Communist whose ideology spreads to George and Kramer.

seinfeld.title: The Switch
seinfeld.description: George suspects that his girlfriend is bulimic; Jerry dates a woman who has a friendlier roommate; Elaine loans out her boss's tennis racket.

seinfeld.title: The Label Maker
seinfeld.description: George objects to his girlfriend's roommate; Super Bowl tickets make the rounds as plans change.

seinfeld.title: The Scofflaw
seinfeld.description: George fails to keep a secret about a friend; Kramer fingers Newman as a scofflaw.

seinfeld.title: The Highlights of 100 (1)
seinfeld.description: The first of a two-part collection of highlights from the first 100 shows includes the characters' ambitions and outside relationships; and George explaining the "show about nothing."

seinfeld.title: The Highlights of 100 (2)
seinfeld.description: The conclusion of a two-part collection of highlights from the first 100 shows includes the characters' concern about their self-images. Also: the evolution of "the contest"; how "marine biologist" George saved a beached whale.

seinfeld.title: The Beard
seinfeld.description: A toupee qualifies George to date Kramer's friend; Elaine tries to change a gay man; Jerry owns up to watching "Melrose Place."

seinfeld.title: The Kiss Hello
seinfeld.description: A physical therapist bothers Jerry, angers George and attracts Kramer. Meanwhile, Kramer promotes friendliness within his building.

seinfeld.title: The Doorman
seinfeld.description: Jerry runs afoul of a doorman; Kramer invents a bra for men. Elaine offends Mr. Pitt's neighbor.

seinfeld.title: The Jimmy
seinfeld.description: A gym member teams with George in business and makes a date with Elaine to see Mel Torme; Jerry suspects his dentist of hanky-panky.

seinfeld.title: The Doodle
seinfeld.description: Jerry's family lives it up at the Plaza for free, thanks to Elaine; the fumigation of Jerry's apartment disables Kramer's taste buds.

seinfeld.title: The Fusilli Jerry
seinfeld.description: Jerry's mechanic "steals" his lovemaking technique; someone's license plates enhance Kramer's image; Mrs. Costanza gets an eye job.

seinfeld.title: The Diplomat's Club
seinfeld.description: A booking agent is overly attentive to Jerry; Pitt puts Elaine in his will; Kramer starts gambling again.

seinfeld.title: The Face Painter
seinfeld.description: Elaine's boyfriend is too zealous a hockey fan; George ventures saying "I love you"; Kramer has an altercation with a chimp.

seinfeld.title: The Understudy
seinfeld.description: Jerry dates Bette Midler's understudy, who gets the call after George injures Bette; Elaine suspects she's being insulted in Korean.

seinfeld.title: The Engagement
seinfeld.description: Jerry reneges on his pact with George to be more like "grown-up men"; Newman takes care of a barking dog that keeps Elaine awake.

seinfeld.title: The Postponement
seinfeld.description: Elaine shares her feelings about George with the wrong person. Meanwhile, George discovers the power of tears.

seinfeld.title: The Maestro
seinfeld.description: A maestro impresses Elaine, jeopardizes Kramer's lawsuit and makes Jerry curious about housing in Italy.

seinfeld.title: The Wink
seinfeld.description: George's involuntary winking is misinterpreted by many, and prompts Kramer to seek a favor from Yankee Paul O'Neill; Jerry tries to hide his distaste for meat from Elaine's cousin.

seinfeld.title: The Hot Tub
seinfeld.description: An Olympic athlete stays at Elaine's; George picks up colloquialisms from Houston Astros execs; Kramer installs a hot tub at his pad.

seinfeld.title: The Soup Nazi
seinfeld.description: Cooing between Jerry and his girlfriend irritates George; Elaine runs afoul of a soup vendor; Kramer loses Elaine's armoire to muggers.

seinfeld.title: The Secret Code
seinfeld.description: George dines with Elaine's boss; Jerry's sleeping foot costs him a commercial; Kramer gives traffic advice to firemen.

seinfeld.title: The Pool Guy
seinfeld.description: An acquaintance latches on to Jerry; George objects to Susan's relationship with his pals; Kramer's new phone number brings many wrong numbers.

seinfeld.title: The Sponge
seinfeld.description: Elaine holds a monopoly on the contraceptive devices that Susan prefers; Kramer refuses to wear a ribbon on his AIDS walk.

seinfeld.title: The Gum
seinfeld.description: Kramer is overprotective of a friend who had a breakdown after dating Elaine; a former neighbor is worried about George's mental stability.

seinfeld.title: The Rye
seinfeld.description: George's parents meet Susan's; Elaine fears her enthusiasm may have scared off the musician she's dating; Kramer drives a hansom cab, but feeds his steed bad fuel.

seinfeld.title: The Caddy
seinfeld.description: Kramer sues Elaine's friend for sinking his golf career; George's apparent work ethic impresses his bosses.

seinfeld.title: The Seven
seinfeld.description: Kramer demands compensation from Elaine for his chiropractic effort; Jerry's flame always wears the same outfit.

seinfeld.title: The Cadillac (1)
seinfeld.description: George becomes obsessed with Marisa Tomei after he's told he's her type; Jerry gives his father a Cadillac.

seinfeld.title: The Cadillac (2)
seinfeld.description: George has a meeting with Marisa Tomei; the Cadillac Jerry buys his father sparks trouble for his dad.

seinfeld.title: The Shower Head
seinfeld.description: Elaine fails a drug test--twice--and loses her job; Jerry talks about his Uncle Leo on "The Tonight Show."

seinfeld.title: The Doll
seinfeld.description: Susan's friend interferes with Jerry's planned jokes; Susan's doll reminds George of his mother; Frank Costanza builds a billiard room.

seinfeld.title: The Friars Club
seinfeld.description: Elaine suspects a co-worker is faking a hearing impairment; Jerry makes a faux pas at the Friars Club after comic Pat Cooper sponsors him for membership.

seinfeld.title: The Wig Master
seinfeld.description: Jerry gets miffed when a salesman hits on Elaine while she's with him; George suspects hookers are conducting business in his parked car.

seinfeld.title: The Calzone
seinfeld.description: George gets his boss, George Steinbrenner, hooked on calzones, then loses his supplier; Kramer warms to clothing fresh from the dryer.

seinfeld.title: The Bottle Deposit (1)
seinfeld.description: Jerry has an argument with his mechanic; Newman becomes obsessed with Michigan's recycling program; Elaine goes to an auction for her boss.

seinfeld.title: The Bottle Deposit (2)
seinfeld.description: While driving a postal truck, Kramer and Newman spot Jerry's stolen car, containing Elaine's JFK golf clubs.

seinfeld.title: The Wait Out
seinfeld.description: Jerry and Elaine see opportunities for themselves when George causes a couple to separate; Kramer can't remove his new jeans.

seinfeld.title: The Invitations
seinfeld.description: Jerry falls for a woman much like himself; George wants out of his wedding, and his fiancée doesn't want Elaine in the wedding party.

seinfeld.title: The Foundation
seinfeld.description: Susan's parents act to preserve her memory; Kramer gives Elaine a confidence boost after Peterman puts her in charge.

seinfeld.title: The Soul Mate
seinfeld.description: Kramer falls for the woman Jerry's seeing; George suspects he's suspected of foul play.

seinfeld.title: The Bizarro Jerry
seinfeld.description: Elaine hangs out with men who are opposites of Jerry, George and Kramer; Kramer stumbles into a white-collar job; Jerry finds a flaw in Elaine's beautiful friend.

seinfeld.title: The Little Kicks
seinfeld.description: Elaine's staff loses respect for her after seeing her dance; George benefits socially when Elaine labels him a "bad seed"; Kramer's friend forces Jerry into crime.

seinfeld.title: The Package
seinfeld.description: Elaine regrets peeking at her medical chart; George takes dating advice from Kramer, who also hatches a scheme to improve Jerry's stereo.

seinfeld.title: The Fatigues
seinfeld.description: An employee's military bent scares Elaine; Kramer cooks for a Jewish singles night; Jerry finds fault with his girlfriend's mentor.

seinfeld.title: The Checks
seinfeld.description: Jerry's popularity in Japan brings new friends to Kramer, and maybe new life to Jerry's TV pilot; Elaine's new beau won't share "his song" with her.

seinfeld.title: The Chicken Roaster
seinfeld.description: George loses an expensive hat Elaine charged to her business account; a neon sign prompts Kramer and Jerry to swap apartments.

seinfeld.title: The Abstinence
seinfeld.description: George's intellect thrives when thoughts of sex are shut out; Elaine wants her intern to become a doctor--stat; Jerry is bumped from a school's Career Day.

seinfeld.title: The Andrea Doria
seinfeld.description: Jerry tries to help Newman get transferred; George trades tales with a shipwreck survivor to obtain a dream apartment; Kramer coughs like a dog; a minor insult has a major effect on Elaine.

seinfeld.title: The Little Jerry
seinfeld.description: George finds a new romance--in a women's prison; Kramer buys a chicken, then puts his fowl to foul use; Elaine encourages her shaved-headed beau to grow back his hair.

seinfeld.title: The Money
seinfeld.description: Kramer's girlfriend disrupts his sleep; Jerry's parents think he needs financial aid; George ponders an inheritance.

seinfeld.title: The Comeback
seinfeld.description: Kramer arranges to die with dignity; Jerry learns his tennis consultant is a lousy player; George becomes obsessed with responding to an insult long after the fact; Elaine offends her video advisor.

seinfeld.title: The Van Buren Boys
seinfeld.description: Gang members protest George's handling of a scholarship named for Susan; some find Jerry's new girlfriend objectionable; Peterman wants Kramer's life experiences for his own autobiography, written by Elaine.

seinfeld.title: The Susie
seinfeld.description: Kramer becomes the spokesman for a woman George wants to avoid; Jerry's bookie welches; a co-worker mistakes Elaine for someone else, who's reported as a problem worker.

seinfeld.title: The Pothole
seinfeld.description: Jerry has an accident with his girlfriend's toothbrush; Elaine crams herself into a restaurant's delivery boundary; Kramer alters his "adopted" highway.

seinfeld.title: The English Patient
seinfeld.description: Elaine's review of a film loses her friends; a woman mistakes George for her boyfriend; Jerry visits his parents in Florida.

seinfeld.title: The Nap
seinfeld.description: George crafts a place to nap at work; a new beau gives Elaine a mattress, which Kramer promptly soils; Jerry's kitchen is redesigned against his will.

seinfeld.title: The Yada Yada
seinfeld.description: George adopts his girlfriend's verbal shorthand; Jerry suspects a comic motive behind his dentist's conversion to Judaism; double-daters Kramer and Mickey don't know whose date is whose.

seinfeld.title: The Millennium
seinfeld.description: The Mets express interest in George; an inattentive saleswoman irks Elaine; Kramer prepares for his millennium party; Jerry jockeys for position on his girlfriend's speed dial.

seinfeld.title: The Muffin Tops
seinfeld.description: George pretends he's a tourist to bond with a tourism worker; Elaine's former boss steals her million-dollar idea, while Kramer promotes a bus tour about the life of Elaine's current boss; Jerry shaves his chest hair.

seinfeld.title: The Summer of George
seinfeld.description: Kramer's job at the Tony Awards leads to a meeting with Raquel Welch; George helps Jerry date a high-maintenance woman; Elaine is labeled catty after making a comment about a co-worker.

seinfeld.title: The Butter Shave
seinfeld.description: Kramer uses butter for shaving--and more; George's cane is an advantage at his new job; Jerry feels used by his comedy nemesis, Bania; Elaine breaks up with her boyfriend before their flight back from Europe.

seinfeld.title: The Voice
seinfeld.description: Kramer hires an assistant; George's boss tries to force him out; Elaine bets Jerry she won't get back with her latest ex.

seinfeld.title: The Serenity Now
seinfeld.description: George goes to work for his father; Jerry's girlfriend wants to see his emotions; Kramer adopts a suburban feel at home; Elaine prompts two Jewish men to renounce their faith.

seinfeld.title: The Blood
seinfeld.description: Kramer stores his own blood to avoid a blood-bank fee; George tries to combine his two passions, sex and food; Elaine's plan to show responsibility backfires; Jerry trains with fitness guru Izzy Mendelbaum.

seinfeld.title: The Junk Mail
seinfeld.description: Kramer battles junk mail; George thinks his parents are trying to avoid him; Jerry acquires a van; and Elaine gets a new man, whose past comes back to haunt her.

seinfeld.title: The Merv Griffin Show
seinfeld.description: Kramer turns his apartment into a talk-show set; Jerry's girlfriend won't let him play with her toys; George's clash with pigeons leads to problems with a squirrel; a new employee's silent movement rattles Elaine.

seinfeld.title: The Slicer
seinfeld.description: George has a past with his new boss; Jerry's "revenge date" backfires; Kramer's deli slicer solves Elaine's problem with a neighbor.

seinfeld.title: The Betrayal
seinfeld.description: Flashbacks trace the evolution of Jerry, George and Elaine's disastrous trip to a wedding in India, and Kramer's desperate need to barter for a birthday wish.

seinfeld.title: The Apology
seinfeld.description: Jerry's girlfriend is naked too often; Elaine's lifestyle offends a co-worker; Kramer seeks to shorten his showers; George has a disagreement with a new AA member.

seinfeld.title: The Strike
seinfeld.description: Kramer returns to work after his 12-year strike is settled; Jerry dates a woman whose appearance fluctuates; George gives holiday gifts in his co-workers' names to a fraudulent charity.

seinfeld.title: The Dealership
seinfeld.description: At a car dealership, Kramer takes a test drive, while Jerry's deal is threatened by a fight between Elaine and Puddy.

seinfeld.title: The Reverse Peephole
seinfeld.description: Elaine gets into a hassle regarding fur; Jerry stops carrying a wallet, while George suffers from his overstuffed one; Kramer keeps Newman from being evicted.

seinfeld.title: The Cartoon
seinfeld.description: An actress turns Jerry's criticism into a one-woman show; Kramer stops talking after offending George; Elaine struggles to understand a cartoon in The New Yorker.

seinfeld.title: The Strong Box
seinfeld.description: Jerry keeps finding Kramer's hidden strongbox key. Elaine dates a mysterious man. George plans a breakup.

seinfeld.title: The Wizard
seinfeld.description: Jerry buys his father an electric organizer; Kramer retires and moves next door to Jerry's parents in Florida; Susan's parents catch George in a lie; Elaine can't tell if she's part of an interracial couple.

seinfeld.title: The Burning
seinfeld.description: Kramer and Mickey play ill for med students; Elaine learns that Puddy's religious; George works out how and when to make a good exit; a tractor figures into the past of Jerry's girlfriend.

seinfeld.title: The Bookstore
seinfeld.description: A bookstore busts Uncle Leo for shoplifting and George for bathroom reading; a misdeed at a company party costs Elaine; Kramer and Newman get a rickshaw, and audition homeless people to pull it.

seinfeld.title: The Frogger
seinfeld.description: George buys an arcade game to preserve his high score; fear of a serial killer adversely affects Jerry's social life; Elaine eats Peterman's slice of wedding cake from the nuptials of the Duke and Duchess of Windsor.

seinfeld.title: The Maid
seinfeld.description: Elaine's area code is changed; a co-worker steals George's desired nickname; Jerry sleeps with his maid; Kramer endures a "long-distance relationship" when his girlfriend moves downtown.

seinfeld.title: The Puerto Rican Day
seinfeld.description: Gridlocked by a parade, Jerry verbally spars with another driver; George goes to a movie; and Kramer looks for a bathroom. Elaine, meanwhile, searches for a crossing point with a group of strangers.

seinfeld.title: The Chronicle (1)
seinfeld.description: Jerry, Elaine, George & Kramer plan to go to a movie, but Jerry takes out a little time to look at nine years of memories.

seinfeld.title: The Chronicle (2)
seinfeld.description: More memories and bloopers.

seinfeld.title: The Finale (1)
seinfeld.description: The gang plans a trip to Paris to celebrate after NBC picks up Jerry and George's sitcom. But there's an in-flight emergency, stranding them in a small town.

seinfeld.title: The Finale (2)
seinfeld.description: Witnesses testify to the gang's (lack of) character as they go on trial for violating a "Good Samaritan Law."

parks-and-recreation.title: Pilot
parks-and-recreation.description: Indiana government worker Leslie Knope is given the assignment to convert an abandoned quarry pit into a community park. A documentary film crew follows Leslie through her mishaps and gaffes as she tries to make her assignment a reality.

parks-and-recreation.title: Canvassing
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie decides that she and her committee need to go door-to-door to gain support for the park project as well as support for an upcoming town hall meeting, but their mission does not go as planned. Meanwhile, Tom wanders away from the canvassing group and uses his own creative recruitment tactics.

parks-and-recreation.title: The Reporter
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie arranges for a reporter to do a story about her park project, but she and her committee have the worst time staying on topic. She then calls Mark to help her save the story, but it ends up hurting more than helping. Meanwhile, Tom does all he can to suck up to his boss.

parks-and-recreation.title: Boys' Club
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie attempts to break into the political "old boy's club," causing an ethical dilemma. Meanwhile, Andy plans a surprise for Ann.

parks-and-recreation.title: The Banquet
parks-and-recreation.description: During a banquet honoring her mother's public service, Leslie tries to convince a local zoning official to support her proposed park project. Meanwhile, Mark and Tom try to meet some ladies.

parks-and-recreation.title: Rock Show
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie attends what she believes is a business meeting with an elderly local government bigwig, unaware that her mother has secretly set her up on a blind date. Andy plays his first gig since breaking both of his legs in the pit.

parks-and-recreation.title: Pawnee Zoo
parks-and-recreation.description: When Leslie decides to marry two penguins to promote the local zoo, she inadvertently causes an uproar when both penguins turn out to be male. Meanwhile, Mark puts Ann in an awkward situation when he asks her to go see a movie.

parks-and-recreation.title: The Stakeout
parks-and-recreation.description: While tending to the new community garden, Leslie and Tom discover someone has planted marijuana among the vegetables. In an effort to catch the people responsible, they pull an all-night stakeout. With Leslie's permission, Ann decides to go on a date with Mark.

parks-and-recreation.title: Beauty Pageant
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie gets to judge a beauty contest, but ends up having conflicting opinions on "the ideal woman" with the other judges. While on a date with Mark, Ann learns Andy has been living in the pit.

parks-and-recreation.title: Practice Date
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie is nervous about her first date with Dave, so Ann takes her on a practice date to help her prepare. Meanwhile, after a local councilman is caught up in a sex scandal, Tom, Ron, April and Mark decide to see who can uncover the worst dirt on each other.

parks-and-recreation.title: Sister City
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie plays host to the Parks and Recreation department from Pawnee's sister city, Boraqua, Venezuela, and is shocked at the cultural differences. Tom becomes an errand boy, and April plays hard to get.

parks-and-recreation.title: Kaboom
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie, Ann and the rest of the Parks Department volunteer to help the organization KaBOOM! build a playground for a neighboring town. After building an entire playground in one day, Leslie gets frustrated at the lack of progress with the pit, and takes some advice from Mark to cut through the red tape.

parks-and-recreation.title: Greg Pikitis
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie enlists the help of Dave and Andy in order to catch a local teen vandal. Meanwhile, Ann struggles to make her Halloween party fun, and ends up getting help from an unlikely source.

parks-and-recreation.title: Ron and Tammy
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie is upset when she learns the library department wants to take over her lot. Making matters worse, the library is run by Ron's ex-wife Tammy, who still has a powerful emotional hold on him. Meanwhile, Andy gets a job in hopes of winning Ann back.

parks-and-recreation.title: The Camel
parks-and-recreation.description: After one of the murals ("The Spirit of Pawnee") in City Hall is defaced, Leslie and the Parks Department compete to come up with a new design. Meanwhile, Andy and Ron share an uncomfortable moment at the shoeshine stand.

parks-and-recreation.title: Hunting Trip
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie tries to prove she can hang with the guys so she invites herself on Ron's annual hunting trip, but things don't go as planned. Meanwhile, April and Andy bond in the office while everyone is away.

parks-and-recreation.title: Tom's Divorce
parks-and-recreation.description: After Leslie finds out that Tom is getting a divorce, the department takes him out on the town to cheer him up. Meanwhile, Andy tries to hustle Mark in a game of pool.

parks-and-recreation.title: Christmas Scandal
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie designs the Pawnee Winter Wonderland Festival, but has to hide from the press when a meeting with a disgraced Councilman lands her in the middle of a sex scandal. Meanwhile, Ron offers to cover for Leslie for the day, and quickly discovers how much work she really does.

parks-and-recreation.title: The Set Up
parks-and-recreation.description: Ann sets Leslie up on a blind date with a co-worker, which does not go as well as Leslie hoped. An old friend of Ann's makes Mark feel insecure.

parks-and-recreation.title: Leslie's House
parks-and-recreation.description: After an amazing date with Justin in Indianapolis, Leslie tries to impress him with a dinner party at her house.

parks-and-recreation.title: Sweetums
parks-and-recreation.description: The Parks Department forms a partnership with a local company to sell energy bars at the parks in Pawnee, but Leslie tries to stop the deal when she discovers how unhealthy the snacks are. Mark reluctantly agrees to help Tom move out of his house.

parks-and-recreation.title: Galentine's Day
parks-and-recreation.description: When Leslie hears her mom's story about an old flame, she and her boyfriend Justin track him down and reunite them on Valentine's Day. Meanwhile, Andy and his band are nervous about playing a gig at the Senior Center.

parks-and-recreation.title: Woman of the Year
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie is outraged when Ron wins a "Woman of the Year" award for a project she started. Meanwhile, Tom is desperate to find some money to invest in a local Pawnee club.

parks-and-recreation.title: The Possum
parks-and-recreation.description: When a possum bites the mayor's dog on a golf course, Leslie is asked to form a task force to catch the pesky animal. Meanwhile, Ron is upset when Mark refuses to bend the rules for him.

parks-and-recreation.title: Park Safety
parks-and-recreation.description: After Jerry gets mugged by a bunch of kids, Leslie meets with the head park ranger in hopes of improving park safety. Meanwhile, everyone tries to be nicer to Jerry once he returns to the office.

parks-and-recreation.title: Summer Catalog
parks-and-recreation.description: Preparing the Summer Events Catalog, Leslie decides to take Ron and the past directors of the Parks Department out for a picnic lunch. Tom enlists the help of Ann and Mark to pose for the cover photo.

parks-and-recreation.title: 94 Meetings
parks-and-recreation.description: Ron is furious when April mistakenly schedules a ton of meetings for him. Meanwhile, Leslie fights to preserve a historical landmark.

parks-and-recreation.title: Telethon
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie hosts a late-night shift for a local telethon, and lands former Indiana Pacer Detlef Schrempf as a celebrity guest. Meanwhile, Mark has big plans for his relationship with Ann.

parks-and-recreation.title: The Master Plan
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie is disappointed when her new park plans are put on hold by a visit from two state auditors. April has plans for Andy at her birthday party, and Ann tries to piece together a romantic mystery.

parks-and-recreation.title: Freddy Spaghetti
parks-and-recreation.description: When Ben prevents Leslie from holding a children's concert, she takes matters into her own hands. Mark makes some big decisions about his life, and Andy gets some unexpected romantic attention.

parks-and-recreation.title: Go Big or Go Home
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie and the Parks Department return to work after three months to discover that the budget crisis still looms. After unsuccessfully trying to have their budget restored by using Ann to charm Chris with a date, Leslie decides to make an all or nothing play by resurrecting the Pawnee Harvest Festival. Meanwhile, Ben restarts the youth basketball league and instates Ron and Andy to coach the only two teams. April returns from a vacation with a new boyfriend.

parks-and-recreation.title: Flu Season
parks-and-recreation.description: While planning for the local Harvest Festival, Leslie is struck with the flu and is forced to go to the hospital. Ron and Andy have a day of male bonding, and Tom hits the spa.

parks-and-recreation.title: Time Capsule
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie wants to bury a time capsule that encapsulates life in Pawnee, but an odd suggestion from a local man causes unforeseen consequences. Andy seeks help from Chris about how to win back April.

parks-and-recreation.title: Ron & Tammy: Part Two
parks-and-recreation.description: Tom tries to get back at Ron by going out on a date with Ron's ex-wife Tammy, while Leslie tries to protect Ron from falling prey to her charms. Meanwhile, April is assigned to work with Chris.

parks-and-recreation.title: Media Blitz
parks-and-recreation.description: While advertising for the Harvest Festival, Ben has to deal with some troubling questions about his past. Meanwhile, Andy continues to try to win April back.

parks-and-recreation.title: Indianapolis
parks-and-recreation.description: Ron and Leslie take a road trip to the big city in order to visit Ron's favorite place which happens to be a steakhouse, but Leslie has alternative motives for the trip.

parks-and-recreation.title: Harvest Festival
parks-and-recreation.description: It's make it or break it for the Parks Department at the Harvest Festival which is full of surprises.

parks-and-recreation.title: Camping
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie takes the whole department camping in order to brainstorm new ideas. Meanwhile, Andy attempts a romantic gesture for April, while Ann gets nervous when Chris returns to Pawnee as the new city manager.

parks-and-recreation.title: Andy and April's Fancy Party
parks-and-recreation.description: April and Andy host a dinner party for the Parks Department. Meanwhile, Ann tries to move on from Chris at a singles' party.

parks-and-recreation.title: Soulmates
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie tries an online dating service, but doesn't end up with a stranger as she expects. Also, Chris challenges Ron to a grilling competition as part of his plans to make Pawnee healthier.

parks-and-recreation.title: Jerry's Painting
parks-and-recreation.description: Jerry's contribution to Leslie's community art show causes a stir. Ben moves in with April and Andy and attempts to teach them how to be adults. Meanwhile, Leslie is frustrated by Chris and his interoffice dating rules.

parks-and-recreation.title: Eagleton
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie's ex-best friend, Lindsay Carlisle Shay, launches an attack on Pawnee, banning residents from visiting a nearby park in the neighboring city of Eagleton with a large fence, causing Leslie to go to war with Eagleton. Meanwhile, everyone finds out that it is Ron's birthday, a fact that he went to extreme lengths to conceal.

parks-and-recreation.title: The Fight
parks-and-recreation.description: When Leslie tries to get Ann a job at city hall, her lukewarm reaction causes their first-ever fight. Tom invites the entire department to the Snakehole Lounge to help him promote his new alcohol, "Snake Juice."

parks-and-recreation.title: Road Trip
parks-and-recreation.description: When Chris sends Leslie and Ben on a trip to Indianapolis, Leslie is afraid she won't be able to deny her feelings for him. Ron teaches a young student about his views on government. Meanwhile, Andy gets his feelings hurt by April after playing Tom's new game.

parks-and-recreation.title: The Bubble
parks-and-recreation.description: Everyone in the office is unhappy when Chris decides to make some big changes in the parks department -- especially Tom who starts to question his career choices. Leslie is caught off guard when Ben has a meeting with her mom.

parks-and-recreation.title: Li'l Sebastian
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie and the parks team put together a memorial service for a dearly departed friend. Meanwhile, Tom makes a big life decision, while Chris reacts badly to a health problem.

parks-and-recreation.title: I'm Leslie Knope
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie is torn between Ben and her dreams of running for public office, while Ron braces himself for the arrival of his first wife, the original Tammy.

parks-and-recreation.title: Ron and Tammys
parks-and-recreation.description: Ron's first ex-wife, Tammy One, reenters his life and tries to control his every move. Meanwhile, Ben helps Tom balance the books at his new company, and Ann makes a PSA, with help from Chris.

parks-and-recreation.title: Born and Raised
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie's book about Pawnee comes out just in time for her campaign. Ann tries to bond with Ron and April.

parks-and-recreation.title: Pawnee Rangers
parks-and-recreation.description: Ron takes his boys-only troop of Pawnee Rangers into the wild. Not wanting the girls to feel left out, Leslie also takes her troop of Pawnee Goddesses on an adventure weekend. Meanwhile, a reluctant Ben joins Tom and Donna for a day of relaxation, and Chris spends some time with Jerry.

parks-and-recreation.title: Meet 'n' Greet
parks-and-recreation.description: Andy and April host a Halloween bash at their house. Tom emcees an event for Leslie's campaign. Andy and April receive an unusual wedding present from Ron and Ann.

parks-and-recreation.title: End of the World
parks-and-recreation.description: A local Pawnee group predicts the end of days, causing chaos in the Parks department.

parks-and-recreation.title: The Treaty
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie enlists the help of Ben, Andy and April to host a Model U.N. for Pawnee Central High School. Chris asks Ann for her advice on love when a date cancels on him. Meanwhile, Ron struggles to find a replacement for Tom.

parks-and-recreation.title: Smallest Park
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie uses her new tourist attraction as a way to spend more time with Ben. Meanwhile, Ron and April encourage Andy to go to college, and Chris tasks Tom and Jerry with revamping the Parks and Rec logo.

parks-and-recreation.title: The Trial of Leslie Knope
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie has to face an ethics committee about her secret relationship with Ben after they come clean to Chris.

parks-and-recreation.title: Citizen Knope
parks-and-recreation.description: Unable to get work done from inside the Parks Department, Leslie forms a citizen action group and fights from the outside. Meanwhile, everyone in the office brainstorms ideas for what to get Leslie for Christmas.

parks-and-recreation.title: The Comeback Kid
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie enlists everyone's help in staging an attention-getting event. Ben takes up a new hobby, while April and Andy adopt a pet.

parks-and-recreation.title: Campaign Ad
parks-and-recreation.description: Faced with a tough new opponent, Leslie and Ben disagree on the content of her first campaign ad. Ron is very uncomfortable when Chris tries to befriend him, while Andy and April make a trip to the doctor.

parks-and-recreation.title: Bowling for Votes
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie and Ben host a bowling night after receiving feedback about Leslie's campaign. April, Chris, and Jerry hold a competition to see who can raise the most funds.

parks-and-recreation.title: Operation Ann
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie works to find Ann a Valentine's date. Ron helps Ben with a scavenger hunt, and Chris becomes depressed over his love life.

parks-and-recreation.title: Dave Returns
parks-and-recreation.description: While trying to get an endorsement from the Chief of Police, Leslie and Ben awkwardly run into Leslie's old flame, Dave. Meanwhile, Andy and the rest of the office work on a theme song for Leslie's campaign.

parks-and-recreation.title: Sweet Sixteen
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie realizes that the department has forgotten Jerry's birthday and decides to throw a party for him at a special location. Meanwhile, Tom is flabbergasted when he finds out Ann doesn't share his taste in music.

parks-and-recreation.title: Campaign Shake-Up
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie and Ben are caught off guard when her opponent Bobby Newport hires a powerful campaign manager from Washington. Chris forces Ron to start interviewing replacements for Leslie when work starts falling through the cracks, and an unlikely officemate solves a challenging problem.

parks-and-recreation.title: Lucky
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie and Ben are thrilled when Buddy Wood wants to interview Leslie for his Indianapolis talkshow. April and Ron prep Andy for his final exam in his Women's Studies course.

parks-and-recreation.title: Live Ammo
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie discovers that the Parks Department budget is about to be cut, and she later meets the City Council member she is running to replace. Chris and Ron visit a meditation center.

parks-and-recreation.title: The Debate
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie goes toe-to-toe with Bobby Newport in a debate. Ann, Tom, and Chris work in the media spin room, while Ron goes the extra mile to save a party for Leslie's donors.

parks-and-recreation.title: Bus Tour
parks-and-recreation.description: An important person in Pawnee dies while Leslie is on a bus tour for the final day of her campaign. Meanwhile Andy investigates a security threat, and Chris finds a cure for his depression.

parks-and-recreation.title: Win, Lose, or Draw
parks-and-recreation.description: It's election day in Pawnee, and Leslie and Bobby Newport are separated by a razor-thin margin. While everyone waits with Leslie for the race to be called, they ponder their futures, and their new opportunities.

parks-and-recreation.title: Ms. Knope Goes to Washington
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie and Andy visit Ben and April at their new jobs in Washington D.C., and Leslie feels overwhelmed by the city -- especially after meeting two of her idols. Meanwhile, Ron throws a "thank you" barbeque for the entire Parks and Recreation staff.

parks-and-recreation.title: Soda Tax
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie decides to wage war on obesity in Pawnee in her first mission as city councilor by passing a city-wide soda tax. Meanwhile, Andy tries to get in shape for his police-entrance exam, and Ben struggles to connect with the interns in his office.

parks-and-recreation.title: How a Bill Becomes a Law
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie helps a local swim team get more practice time by working on a new law that extends the hours at the community pool; Ron finds himself filling a pothole for a local woman (Lucy Lawless) as part of Chris' new plan to solve citizens' problems around the city; April and Ben take a road trip to Pawnee.

parks-and-recreation.title: Sex Education
parks-and-recreation.description: An STD outbreak amongst Pawnee seniors prompts Leslie to conduct a sex education class. Meanwhile, Ron helps Tom adjust to life without technology after his gadgets are taken away, and Ben and April meet Congressman Murray for the first time.

parks-and-recreation.title: Halloween Surprise
parks-and-recreation.description: A new job offer for Ben causes Leslie to contemplates their future. Meanwhile, Ron and Andy take Diane's girls out trick-or-treating, and Tom searches for a new business idea.

parks-and-recreation.title: Ben's Parents
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie is nervous about meeting Ben's divorced parents. Tom prepares to pitch his new business to Ron with Jean-Ralphio's help. Chris rides an emotional rollercoaster.

parks-and-recreation.title: Leslie vs. April
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie gets upset when April tries to get Lot 48 made into a dog park. Meanwhile, Tom enlists Ben's help as he tries to launch his new business venture, and Andy hones his crime scene investigation skills.

parks-and-recreation.title: Pawnee Commons
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie and Ben meet with an architect from their rival town, Eagleton, about designs for a new park.

parks-and-recreation.title: Ron and Diane
parks-and-recreation.description: Ron, Diane, and Leslie attend a wood working awards dinner after one of Ron's handcrafted chairs is nominated, but the happy occasion is threatened by the arrival of Tammy II. Meanwhile, Jerry hosts a holiday party at his home with his wife, and some of his friends are shocked to find they were not invited.

parks-and-recreation.title: Two Parties
parks-and-recreation.description: Ben and Leslie's rival bachelor and bachelorette parties each take on a very different tune.

parks-and-recreation.title: Women in Garbage
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie and April handle a garbage route, while Tom asks Andy and Ben to teach him about basketball. Meanwhile, Ron is left to watch Diane's kids while their babysitter is out of town.

parks-and-recreation.title: Ann's Decision
parks-and-recreation.description: Ann tries to get to know herself as Leslie meddles in one of her biggest life decisions. Meanwhile, things go south when Ben enlists the guys to help choose a caterer for the wedding.

parks-and-recreation.title: Emergency Response
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie and Ben organize a black tie gala to raise money for their park, but their plans are derailed when a city-wide emergency response drill is called. Meanwhile, Andy prepares to take his Police Academy Exam and Ron fills in for Leslie on Pawnee Today.

parks-and-recreation.title: Leslie and Ben
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie and Ben are getting married, and have to cram months of planning into two hours. Meanwhile, Ron's temper gets him in trouble.

parks-and-recreation.title: Correspondents' Lunch
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie's speech she prepared for a special event is stolen. Ben begins his new job at the Sweetums Charity Foundation. Ann summons the courage to ask an important question.

parks-and-recreation.title: Bailout
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie is determined to help a local video store stay in business, while Chris offers Tom advice on how to deal with a difficult employee. Elsewhere, Ann resorts to blackmail to get April to be her friend.

parks-and-recreation.title: Partridge
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie accompanies Ben on a trip to his hometown which has offered him a key to the city. Ron deals with a lawsuit filed against him by Councilman Jamm. Ann and Chris take a parenting compatibility quiz.

parks-and-recreation.title: Animal Control
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie decides to give the Animal Control Department a much-needed makeover. Ann tries to get Ron the medical attention he needs. Ben, Tom, and Andy recruit donors for their charity foundation.

parks-and-recreation.title: Article Two
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie works to get rid of outdated laws from the original town charter. April and Ron receive management training from Chris. Ben finds himself in a bidding war against Ann to win a present for Leslie.

parks-and-recreation.title: Jerry's Retirement
parks-and-recreation.description: When Leslie finds out Jerry is retiring, she struggles with the proper way to commemorate the occasion. Chris and Ann prepare to have a baby together. Tom worries he will become the office punching bag once Jerry leaves.

parks-and-recreation.title: Swing Vote
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie deems Ron's budget-cut proposals unacceptable. Andy and Ben celebrate a big donation made to their charity. Ann tries to solve Tom's girlfriend troubles.

parks-and-recreation.title: Are You Better Off?
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie celebrates her first year as a city councilwoman. Retired Special Agent Burt Macklin is recalled to action. April gets some life-changing news. Tom debates a big business opportunity.

parks-and-recreation.title: London
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie wins an award from an international Women in Government organization, and travels to London with Ben, Andy, April and Ron to accept it.

parks-and-recreation.title: The Pawnee-Eagleton Tip-Off Classic
parks-and-recreation.description: Ben, Leslie and Chris meet with Eagleton city councilor Ingrid de Forest to discuss financial matters; Ann brings April to vet school orientation; Ron tries to get off the grid.

parks-and-recreation.title: Doppelgängers
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie pairs up the Pawnee Parks employees with their Eagleton counterparts. Meanwhile Ben and Chris reunite for an accounting project, and Ann reveals her plans for the future.

parks-and-recreation.title: Gin It Up!
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie tries to calm a minor scandal that gets blown out of proportion. Tom tries to impress a new love interest, while Ben convinces Ron to prepare a will.

parks-and-recreation.title: Filibuster
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie throws Ben a birthday bash but is forced to leave early for an emergency late-night filibuster. Tom tries to make some memories with his new girlfriend, Ron and Donna go hunting. April reconnects with Andy.

parks-and-recreation.title: Recall Vote
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie prepares a haunted house with Ben, Ann and Chris for Halloween on the day of the recall vote. Meanwhile, Tom fears the end of Rent-A-Swag and persuades Ron to help save his business.

parks-and-recreation.title: Fluoride
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie tries to complete some of her biggest city council goals, like hosting an NFL Play 60 event with the Indianapolis Colts, and trying to add fluoride to Pawnee's drinking water. Meanwhile, Chris and Ron attempt to bond while building cribs for their future children.

parks-and-recreation.title: The Cones of Dunshire
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie faces off with Councilman Jamm; Ben gets a new hobby; Tom, April and Donna help Ron sell his cabin.

parks-and-recreation.title: Second Chunce
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie comes to terms with her last day in office and plans for the future with Ben. Chris and Ann find out the sex of their child, Andy comes home from London, and Tom looks to the future.

parks-and-recreation.title: New Beginnings
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie and Ben both face new challenges on the first day of new jobs. Donna, April and Andy play a prank on Ben, while Tom prepares for a big presentation. Meanwhile Ann and Chris contemplate taking a big leap together.

parks-and-recreation.title: Farmers Market
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie fights with Ben over questionable sales techniques at the local farmers market. Ann searches for a way to vent about the annoying aspects of pregnancy, while April supports Andy in a new creative venture.

parks-and-recreation.title: Ann and Chris
parks-and-recreation.description: On Ann and Chris's last night in Pawnee, Leslie throws a grand farewell party and attempts to fulfill one last promise. Meanwhile, Tom, Ben, Ron and Andy struggle to find the perfect going away gift for Chris.

parks-and-recreation.title: Anniversaries
parks-and-recreation.description: Ben attempts to surprise Leslie with a special anniversary gift. Tom and Adam try to help Leslie bring positive light to the Pawnee-Eagleton merger, while April asserts her new authority as Donna's boss.

parks-and-recreation.title: The Wall
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie's efforts to take down the wall separating Eagleton and Pawnee yield unexpected results; Ben and Tom meet with possible sponsors for the concert; Ron finds a new hobby.

parks-and-recreation.title: New Slogan
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie aims to create a new town slogan, but runs afoul of local shock jocks. Andy scouts bands to play the Unity Concert and discovers an interesting secret about Ron, while Tom looks for a restaurant locale with Donna and April.

parks-and-recreation.title: Galentine's Day
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie throws a hasty Galentine's Day in an attempt to find a replacement for Ann. Tom and Ben look to finalize a deal on tents for the Unity Concert, while Ron finds himself looking after Andy.

parks-and-recreation.title: Prom
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie helps organize the high school's Senior Prom, and battles with Ron over the future employment of a bright high school senior. Andy takes an unwilling April as his date, and Tom is tasked with DJ'ing and agrees to let Ben help.

parks-and-recreation.title: Flu Season 2
parks-and-recreation.description: In the midst of flu season, a sick Leslie and Andy struggle to book performers for the Unity Concert. Meanwhile, Tom heads to a wine competition in search of a sommelier for his new restaurant, and Ben seeks drunken help from Ron with a personal problem.

parks-and-recreation.title: One in 8,000
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie and Ben run a charity auction to raise funds for the unity concert. April steps in to manage Andy's schedule, while Donna asks Ron for help with her ex-boyfriend.

parks-and-recreation.title: Moving Up
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie, Ben, and Andy head to San Francisco for a National Parks Conference. Tom opens his restaurant, Ron has another run-in with his ex-wife Tammy 2, Andy lives a rock and roll fantasy, and Leslie makes a huge decision about her future.

Leslie launches a competition with tech company Gryzzl for a large parcel of land, which she wants to turn into a National Park. April and Andy try to regain their spontaneity. Ben is recognized at a Bicentennial gala, where Tom delivers a speech in his honor.

parks-and-recreation.title: Ron and Jammy
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie and Ron briefly put aside their feud to help old foe Jeremy Jamm escape the clutches of the diabolical Tammy 2. Ben vows to help April discover her true passion in life, while Andy and Tom travel to Chicago.

parks-and-recreation.title: William Henry Harrison
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie's team tries to strengthen her case that the Newport land should be turned into a National Park. Ron's team, fighting back, brings on a celebrity as a minority owner.

parks-and-recreation.title: Leslie and Ron
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie and Ron attempt to work out their differences.

parks-and-recreation.title: Gryzzlbox
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie and Ben suspect that Gryzzl is invading the privacy of Pawnee residents. April addresses the new Parks and Rec interns, while Tom helps Andy renegotiate a contract.

parks-and-recreation.title: Save JJ's
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie holds a rally in an attempt to keep JJ's Diner from closing. Tom surprises Donna with the ultimate pre-wedding gift.

parks-and-recreation.title: Donna and Joe
parks-and-recreation.description: Donna and Joe tie the knot, while April attempts to keep the wedding running smoothly. Ron creates an awkward situation between Tom and Lucy. Jen Barkley arrives at Ben and Leslie's house with an interesting opportunity.

parks-and-recreation.title: Ms. Ludgate-Dwyer Goes to Washington
parks-and-recreation.description: While Leslie and April take a business trip to Washington, April wrestles with her future. Back in Pawnee, Andy tries to find April the perfect job.

parks-and-recreation.title: Pie-Mary
parks-and-recreation.description: Leslie and Ben come under fire for participating in an old Pawnee tradition. April and Ron go on a scavenger hunt. Donna and Garry stroll down memory lane.

parks-and-recreation.title: The Johnny Karate Super Awesome Musical Explosion Show
parks-and-recreation.description: On the last episode of Andy's TV show, his friends wish him luck with whatever comes next.

parks-and-recreation.title: Two Funerals
parks-and-recreation.description: Ben and April conduct a series of interviews, while Andy and Donna help Ron adjust to a life change.

parks-and-recreation.title: One Last Ride
parks-and-recreation.description: The Parks gang completes one last task together, before saying goodbye to Pawnee.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Pilot
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When tightly wound Capt. Holt takes over the precinct, carefree Det. Jake Peralta and his dysfunctional coworkers' lives get demanding.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Tagger
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake is assigned a lowly graffiti case as punishment for being late to roll call.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Slump
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake's unsolved cases pile up and the other detectives fear that his losing streak will rub off on them, while Amy must run an at-risk youth program.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: M.E. Time
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: The team turns on Jake for delaying an autopsy report by flirting with an attractive medical examiner, who turns out to be more than he bargained for.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Vulture
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: A Major Crimes detective known as "The Vulture" takes over Jake's nearly solved case and steals his thunder, prompting revenge.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Halloween
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Halloween-hating Amy is anything but festive when she has to don a costume and hit the streets with Charles on busy Halloween night.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: 48 Hours
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: After making an arrest with too little proof, Jake has 48 hours to get evidence or the perp will go free, forcing the team to work over the weekend.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Old School
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake's dream day with his hero, a former crime reporter, turns nightmarish when his comments about Holt and the precinct go "on the record."

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Sal's Pizza
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When Jake's favorite pizzeria is burned down and the fire marshal suspects the owner, Jake steps outside his jurisdiction to catch the real arsonist.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Thanksgiving
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Amy hosts Thanksgiving dinner for the precinct in an effort to get Holt to be her mentor, but Holt and Jake leave early and the rest hate her cooking.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Christmas
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When Capt. Holt receives death threats, Jake is placed on his protective detail and revels in the chance to boss his boss around.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Pontiac Bandit
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Rosa hunt an infamous car thief, Holt tries to find a home for puppies and the rest of the precinct tries to accommodate a wounded Charles.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Bet
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: After Jake and Amy's bet about who can make more arrests is finally settled, the two go on a stakeout where Jake reevaluates their relationship.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Ebony Falcon
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: On his first task back in the field, Terry takes advice from Jake on controlling his emotions to infiltrate and bust a steroid trafficking ring.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Operation: Broken Feather
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: While investigating a string of hotel robberies together, Jake discovers that Amy may transfer to the Major Crimes unit and work with "The Vulture."

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Party
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: At Capt. Holt's birthday party, Jake, Amy and the other officers try to make a good impression on Holt's husband but fail miserably.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Full Boyle
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: To stop Detective Boyle from getting too clingy, or "Full Boyle," with his new girlfriend, Jake goes on their date, but things don't go as planned.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Apartment
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When Jake's building goes co-op and he must pay nearly a half million dollars to keep his apartment, he desperately seeks Gina's help.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Tactical Village
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: At Tactical Village, where the precinct competes against other precincts in paintball exercises, Jake gets jealous when Amy runs into an old flame.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Fancy Brudgom
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When Charles makes Jake his best man, it means cake tasting, choosing flowers and convincing fiancée Vivian that Charles doesn't want to move.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Unsolvable
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: On a solving streak, Jake decides to spend his weekend off with Sgt. Terry trying to crack a cold case that no one thinks can be solved.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Charges and Specs
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake risks suspension when the commissioner shuts down his investigation of a civic leader and he gets Amy and Holt to help him work the case anyway.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Undercover
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When Jake discovers that a mobster escaped his otherwise successful sting, he enlists Charles to help track him down, which worries Gina.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Chocolate Milk
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Holt's nemesis heads the precinct inspection, while Terry readies for his vasectomy and Charles needs a date for his ex-wife's engagement party.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Jimmy Jab Games
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When a motorcade detail is delayed, it leads to a wacky competition, and Charles must get an incriminating videotape from Hitchcock.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Halloween II
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: For their annual Halloween wager, Jake bets Holt that he can steal his watch before midnight, and Gina gets kicked off her dance squad, Floorgasm.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Mole
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Holt and Jake search for a mole in the precinct, and Terry and Rosa visit a silent disco to find "Giggle Pig" dealers.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Jake and Sophia
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake is attracted to a woman he soon discovers is the attorney for a perp he's after, and Rosa gets Amy to run for union rep to replace Scully.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Lockdown
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When the precinct goes into lockdown on Thanksgiving night, it's up to Jake to keep morale high, even as things spiral out of control.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: USPIS
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: To catch a drug dealer, Jake and Charles must team up with an incompetent Postal Service investigator. Meanwhile, the team helps Amy quit smoking.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Road Trip
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When Jake and Amy have to stay overnight at a hotel for a case, Jake invites Sophia and Amy's boyfriend Teddy over, but the move backfires.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Pontiac Bandit Returns
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Rosa catch the Pontiac Bandit, who could lead them to the Giggle Pig kingpin. Charles and Gina worry about their parents getting close.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Stakeout
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Charles go on a stakeout that lasts way too long, and Terry writes a book for his daughters that angers Amy and Gina.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Beach House
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake ruins the precinct's annual beach house getaway when he's pressured into bringing Captain Holt. Gina wants to see "six-drink Amy."

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Payback
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake has to go to great lengths to keep a secret about Terry from the rest of the precinct, and Amy finally gets to partner up with Captain Holt.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Defense Rests
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When his relationship with Sophia gets in the way of her work, Jake tries to help, Wuntch needs Holt's help, and Charles wants Gina's blessing.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Windbreaker City
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: The Nine-Nine is invited to a terrorist training drill with Homeland Security, but the precinct's role as hostages doesn't go over so well.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Wednesday Incident
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake is determined to prove that he's not to blame for Holt's bad mood, and when Charles catches a notorious bank robber, nobody believes him.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Boyle-Linetti Wedding
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: It's wedding day for Charles and Gina's parents, and everyone in the squad is given duties; but Jake and Gina get distracted, and Terry has troubles.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Captain Peralta
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When Jake's absentee father visits, Charles suspects he's up to no good. Holt throws down a brain twister challenge.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Sabotage
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Holt makes Amy and Rosa investigate Jake's bad luck, but he also insults Gina. Charles partners with Hitchcock and Scully.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: AC/DC
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Terry forces Jake to take time off after he's injured chasing a perp, and Holt and Rosa go on an awkward double date with their significant others.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Det. Dave Majors
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake gets jealous over another detective's romantic interest in Amy, and Terry is tempted to accept a job at a private security firm.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Chopper
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Holt worries Jake is being set up to fail when Wuntch green lights his dream assignment, and Terry hosts a field trip for a magnet school.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Johnny and Dora
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Amy go undercover to catch an infamous identity thief, and the squad is rocked by an unexpected farewell.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: New Captain
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: The precinct's new captain makes an unforgettable first impression. Jake and Amy try to keep their budding romance under wraps.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Funeral
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Another shakeup at the precinct spells trouble for Jake and Amy, while a string of disappointments sends Holt into a downward spiral.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Boyle's Hunch
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: A smitten Boyle vows to get a fellow foodie out of prison by proving her innocence. Holt's bid to boost cops' public image sparks a backlash.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Oolong Slayer
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: While Jake and Holt secretly team up to hunt for a serial killer, Amy and Rosa seek revenge for a sexist assignment.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Halloween III
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: For their annual Halloween heist, Jake and Holt draft teams and compete to steal a crown. But Amy's divided loyalties leave her out in the cold.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Into the Woods
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Charles whisk Terry away for an ill-fated camping trip, while Holt helps Rosa with a dilemma, and Amy tries to cash in on an old invention.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Mattress
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: A lovers' spat leads to trouble on the job as Jake and Amy chase down a new street drug. A parking mishap drives a wedge between Holt and Boyle.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Ava
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake jumps into action when Terry's wife goes into labor at the precinct. Meanwhile, an Internet outage forces the team to go old-school.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Swedes
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Tensions flare as Jake and Rosa work a case with two peculiar Swedish cops. Neil deGrasse Tyson drops by to help Gina prepare for a big test.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Yippie Kayak
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: A last-minute Christmas shopping trip lands Jake, Gina and Charles in the middle of a "Die Hard"-like hostage crisis.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Hostage Situation
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Boyle tries to recover some sensitive cargo held hostage by his ruthless ex-wife. Amy injures Terry at the worst possible moment.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: 9 Days
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: An illness leaves Jake and Holt quarantined and delusional as they try to solve a cold case. Terry discovers running the precinct is messy work.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Cruise
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Amy embark on a romantic cruise, only to find an old adversary aboard. Holt braces for a visit from his melodramatic sister.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Karen Peralta
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Amy gears up to meet Jake's mother on his birthday, but the celebration takes an unexpected turn. New body cameras prove embarrassing for Boyle.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The 9-8
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Sparks fly when a neighboring precinct moves in with the Nine-Nine. Jake's reunion with an old partner yields an unhappy surprise.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: House Mouses
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake persuades Scully and Hitchcock to take over a drug bust so he can help out with a "celebrity" matter. But neither case is what the team expected.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Adrian Pimento
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: A cop fresh off an undercover stint with the mob has trouble readjusting to precinct life. Boyle's culinary exploits trigger a janitorial standoff.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Cheddar
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Amy volunteer to house-sit for Holt, with disastrous results. The chemistry between Rosa and Pimento heats up.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Terry Kitties
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: An adorable special delivery reminds Terry of an unsolved case that's haunted him for years. With Jake's help, he sets out to finally crack it.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Paranoia
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: A whirlwind engagement sends the gang scrambling to throw twin bachelor and bachelorette parties. But the night of revelry takes an unexpected turn.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Maximum Security
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: To root out the crooked FBI agent who targeted Pimento, the team stages an elaborate fake funeral and sends Amy on a risky undercover mission.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Bureau
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: With help from an old friend of Holt's, the gang sneaks into the FBI to find dirt on the double agent. An inmate puts Charles in an awkward position.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Greg and Larry
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and the team scour the hospital for a captive Captain Holt, while Amy and Charles book it back to New York to help their friends.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Coral Palms (1)
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Holt continue their new lives in Florida under the Witness Protection Program while Jimmy remains at large, but their identities may be revealed after a video of the pair goes viral.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Coral Palms (2)
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Holt end up on the other side of the interrogation table after being caught plotting an attack on Figgis. Meanwhile, a questionable new captain takes over at the precinct.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Coral Palms (3)
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: The team makes a road trip to Florida to try to help Jake and Holt take down Figgis. With an unforeseen injury and yet another interruption by Sheriff Reynolds, the plan doesn’t follow through quite like they all had hoped. In the midst of the chaos, Jake and Amy share an awkward reunion.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Night Shift (I)
brooklyn-nine-nine.description:
As Jake struggles with his first case back at the precinct, he encounters Jess Day, who is visiting New York, and enlists her to help him find his suspect. Meanwhile, Holt researches ways to increase office morale and Amy tries to figure out why Rosa keeps taking such long breaks.

The crossover continues on New Girl S06E04 Homecoming (II).

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Halloween IV
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: It’s Halloween in the Nine-Nine, which can only mean one thing: heist time. This year, the squad members pull out all the stops in their quest to win the new defending title of “Ultimate Detective Slash Genius.” Lines are drawn and plans are made, but there can only be one reigning champion.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Monster in the Closet
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Pimento and Rosa decide to pick up where they left off and get married, so the whole squad preps a perfect wedding under Amy’s careful direction. Pimento enlists Jake and Gina to hunt for his grandmother’s ruby earrings for Rosa to wear in the ceremony, but the universe has other plans for them.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Mr. Santiago
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: At Amy's intricately planned Thanksgiving dinner, Jake goes "full Santiago" (binder and all) in order to impress her father, a former cop. With Jake and Amy's focus elsewhere, Charles is left on turkey duty and Holt helps Pimento cope after learning he can no longer work for the NYPD.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Skyfire Cycle
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When famous author DC Parlov receives death threats, Jake and Terry take the case, so that Terry can meet his lifelong hero. Back at the precinct, Gina forces her way into the Boyle clan of cousins in an attempt to choose the location of the annual Boyle family vacation. Meanwhile, Holt's anger peaks when Amy chooses Kevin's side in their argument about a math puzzle.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Overmining
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Captain "CJ" is having major problems with a big case, and Jake and Holt find the motivation to help him out. Inside the precinct, war ensues when Terry enforces a green initiative and tells Gina to get rid of her precious space heater, while Rosa and Boyle take a break from the night shift to visit a foot massage parlor.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Captain Latvia
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Charles enlists Jake's help in tracking down his son's favorite toy for Christmas, and the two find themselves accidentally facing off against a Latvian criminal ring as a result. Back at the precinct, the team gears up for their annual Christmas carol competition against their sworn enemy: the MTA.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Fugitive (1)
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When a prison-van escape sets nine convicts loose in the city, Jake and Amy compete to see who can bring in the most fugitives.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Fugitive (2)
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: The effort to capture prison escapees continues. Jake teams up with an unlikely ally who's related to one of the convicts.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Audit
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Due to low crime rates, Brooklyn decides to close one of its precincts. The future of the Nine-Nine depends on an audit conducted by Amy’s boring ex.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Serve & Protect
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Rosa tackle a case of a missing laptop on the set of a long-running TV police procedural. Terry’s vengeful ex takes over the audit.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Last Ride
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: The squad learns it's dangerously close to being shut down. Jake and Charles go out on one last case that quickly escalates into a major drug bust.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Moo Moo
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: After getting stopped and mistreated by an unfamiliar cop, Terry receives some disappointing advice from Holt about how to handle the profiling.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Cop-Con
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Eager to blow off steam, the squad tries to keep Holt in the dark as they throw a secret party during a police convention in upstate New York.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Chasing Amy
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Rosa go on a search mission after a stressed-out Amy disappears on the day of her sergeant's exam. Gina inherits a Boyle family heirloom.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Your Honor
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: While looking into a break-in at Holt's mother's house, Jake discovers a secret she’s been keeping from her son. The squad remodels the break room.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Slaughterhouse
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: A drug case leads Jake and Rosa to an investigation conducted by their shared idol, Lt. Hawkins, who indicates she may have a job for one of them.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Bank Job
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Rosa call for backup from Holt and Pimento after their search for bank robbers turns dangerous. Boyle disapproves of Gina's new boyfriend.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Crime & Punishment
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When Jake and Rosa find themselves framed for a crime they didn't commit, the squad must cook up an exceptionally creative solution.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Big House (1)
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Stuck behind bars, Jake lands in trouble over some delicious contraband. Fellow inmate Rosa keeps Holt and Terry busy with a never-ending to-do list.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Big House (2)
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: As the squad looks for ways to implicate the corrupt Lt. Hawkins, Jake puts his detective skills to work with help from his affable cannibal cellmate.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Kicks
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Freed from prison and back on duty, Jake hunts for a sneaker thief under Holt's watchful eye. Meanwhile, Rosa suspects Pimento of infidelity.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: HalloVeen
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake pulls off a major surprise during the squad's annual Halloween heist, a cutthroat competition to claim the coveted title of Amazing Human/Genius.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Bad Beat
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: An undercover operation brings out Holt's inner gambler. Rosa tries to out-laze Hitchcock and Scully. Charles buys a food truck with an unsavory past.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Venue
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Nemeses plague the squad, as Jake and Amy's big day gets derailed by the Vulture, and Charles must find his missing equine foe, Sgt. Peanut Butter.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Two Turkeys
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: On Thanksgiving, alcohol provides a temporary fix to Jake and Amy's parental problems, and a pilfered pie awakens the ruthless interrogator in Holt.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Return to Skyfire
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Terry go undercover at a costume-packed fan convention when their favorite fantasy author reports his much-anticipated manuscript stolen.
After missing their flight home from a funeral in LA, Jake and the squad scramble to get Holt back to New York in time for a big interview.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Game Night
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Intensely private Rosa shares personal news with the team but wants Jake's help to tell her parents. Cyber Crimes steals the Nine-Nine's bandwidth.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Favor
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Crime boss Seamus Murphy resurfaces to claim his promised favor from Holt, so Jake and Charles befriend the Murphy family's Fredo to get information.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Safe House
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: After a threat from Murphy, Holt stashes husband Kevin in a safe house with Jake. Rosa goes undercover at a salon. Scully reveals an actual skill.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Negotiation
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Tapped to negotiate a hostage situation, Jake realizes the perp is someone he knows. Meanwhile, tensions flare inside Charles's meatball food truck.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Box
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: As Jake begins an intense interrogation of a wily dentist suspected of murder, an opera-bound Holt jumps in to assist. Sterling K. Brown guest-stars.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Puzzle Master
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake brings Amy in on an arson case connected to her celebrity crush, a crossword puzzle author. The Nine-Nine gets a sweet new detective car.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: NutriBoom
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: After realizing they were suckered into a pyramid scheme, Jake and Charles try to take down the cultish group. Amy deals with an overeager officer.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: DFW
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake's attempt to connect with his half sister goes off the rails. Terry tries and fails to show his flexibility. Gina sets Rosa up on a blind date.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Gray Star Mutual
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: A familiar face pops up when disaster strikes Charles's food truck. Rosa offers to help Amy pick out a wedding gown. Holt sets up a Twitter account.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Bachelor/ette Party
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Charles's convoluted bachelor party plans frustrate Jake, Terry and Holt. At her bachelorette bash, Amy plays a revealing game of "Never Have I Ever."

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Show Me Going
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: An anxious Nine-Nine awaits news on Rosa after she enters an active shooter situation. Amy and Gina distract themselves by taking on a plumbing issue.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: White Whale
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: As Rosa and Amy hunt a criminal who escaped their clutches years ago, Jake takes over wedding prep. Holt faces off with his rival for commissioner.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Jake & Amy
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When Jake and Amy suffer a wedding day crisis, the Nine-Nine attempts to salvage the nuptials. Holt receives news on his bid for the commissioner job.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Honeymoon
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: An unexpected third wheel puts a damper on Jake and Amy's tropical honeymoon. Back at the Nine-Nine, Terry experiences a crisis of confidence.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Hitchcock & Scully
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Charles investigate a case of Hitchcock and Scully's from the 1980s. Meanwhile, Amy's uniformed officers and Terry's detectives fight over limited resources.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Tattler
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Gina attend their 20th high school reunion. Back at the Nine-Nine, Charles helps Rosa with her love life.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Four Movements
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: After Gina makes a life-changing decision, she bestows a series of gifts on the squad. But first, an interpretive dance ...

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: A Tale of Two Bandits
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake investigates a series of car thefts that point to an old frenemy. Meanwhile, the squad defends their favorite bar from interlopers.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Crime Scene
