brooklyn-nine-nine.description: A promise made to a grieving mother sends Jake spiraling into obsession as he and Rosa comb the scene of a baffling murder for clues.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Honeypot
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Holt and Jake become suspicious of a new Nine-Nine employee. Amy goes full-on Marie Kondo to declutter the bullpen.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: He Said, She Said
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Amy and Jake hear conflicting stories as they investigate a sexual assault accusation. Holt refuses to believe an old nemesis is really dead.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Golden Child
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake helps Amy navigate the complicated relationship she has with her brother, David. Charles introduces some drama into an undercover mission involving Terry and Holt.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Gintars
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: A visitor from Latvia causes Charles and Jake to investigate Nikolaj's family. Holt and Amy bring in famed forensic scientist Dr. Yee to help close a case for Rosa.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Therapist
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: A missing person case forces Jake to confront his issues with therapy. Holt invites Rosa and her new girlfriend to dinner. Terry overcompensates.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Casecation
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: While celebrating their first anniversary, Jake and Amy realize they've had a communication breakdown over a major life decision.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Bimbo
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: A burglary investigation at Kevin's university reveals Holt's hidden insecurity. Amy and Terry's efforts to raise morale turn deliciously cutthroat.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Ticking Clocks
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: As Hitchcock and Scully microwave a lasagna for exactly 21 minutes and 30 seconds, the squad races against the clock to catch a hacker.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Return of the King
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Gina invites Jake and Terry over to her new place. Holt takes an interest in Nikolaj's education. Rosa rejects Amy's offer of a helping hand.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Cinco de Mayo
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Mayhem and double-crossing overtake the squad as they try to distract Terry from his lieutenant's exam by kicking off the Halloween Heist on a new day.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Sicko (1)
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Boyle hunt for a serial killer under the watchful eye of Commissioner Kelly. Terry learns that more money does indeed bring more problems.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Suicide Squad (2)
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: To right a wrong, the Nine-Nine teams up with the worst of the worst of the NYPD. Terry sinks into deep denial about his future.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Manhunter
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake finds his authority tested and thunder stolen by a beat-walking Holt amid a manhunt. Amy turns to Rosa for support during a personal crisis.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Captain Kim
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When an interim captain arrives at the Nine-Nine, Jake sets out to prove she's way too good to be true. Boyle rebrands his image.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Pimemento
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Adrian Pimento resurfaces with a "Finding Dory"-esque memory problem. Jake tries to keep a secret from Boyle. The squad attends a mandatory HR seminar.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Jimmy Jab Games II
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake revives the Jimmy Jab Games, with Boyle going full-on P.T. Barnum as host of the competition and Holt's timid new partner reluctantly joining in.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Debbie
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: The squad suspects an inside job when guns and cocaine connected to a notorious crime boss go missing from the Nine-Nine.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Trying
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Time flies as Jake and Amy focus on their family plans. Holt bristles over his tedious new job. A tooth-wielding Hitchcock searches for his Cinderella.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Ding Dong
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Holt risks his career by refusing to let his greatest nemesis have the last word. Boyle and Terry compete for Jake's tickets to an exclusive kid event.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Takeback
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: The reappearance of Doug Judy lands Jake in hot water. Terry scrambles to replace Holt's treasured keepsake. The Nine-Nine gets a new vending machine.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Dillman
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When an apparent prank destroys a key piece of evidence, Holt taps the best detective he knows to interrogate the squad and bring the culprit to justice.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Admiral Peralta
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake doubles down on his daddy issues during a tense family reunion. Holt turns into a musical taskmaster over Terry's audition with the NYPD band.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Valloweaster
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: A pudgy pooch, handcuffs and various other disasters delay the crowning of the squad's newest Amazing Human/Genius in the annual Halloween Heist.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Ransom
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Holt turns to Jake for help after a family member goes missing. Rosa battles Amy's ex for a coveted prize. Boyle and Terry team up on a business scheme.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Lights Out
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Amy takes charge of the Nine-Nine during a citywide blackout, while Jake hits one snag after another as he races to her side.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Good Ones
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Amy returns from maternity leave. Jake and Rosa work a difficult case.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Lake House
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: The squad takes up Holt on an offer for a weekend getaway.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Blue Flu
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Captain Holt and Amy manage an understaffed precinct. Jake and Charles investigate.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Balancing
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Amy create a system to balance work and childcare and Rosa gets a new houseguest.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: PB&J
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake takes an old friend for a ride.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Set Up
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: When the FBI takes over a high-profile case, Jake keeps digging. Amy and Rosa negotiate with O'Sullivan and the police union.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Game of Boyles
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Jake and Terry accompany Charles to the funeral of his Great Uncle Pappy — and uncover a family secret. Rosa nudges Holt back into the dating pool.

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: Renewal
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: Amid planning for a vow renewal ceremony, Holt makes a big announcement — one that he asks Jake not to share with Amy. Plus, Cheddar wears a bow tie!

brooklyn-nine-nine.title: The Last Day
brooklyn-nine-nine.description: The squad takes stock of its eight years together and looks toward the future.

frasier.title: The Good Son
frasier.description: Psychiatrist Frasier Crane returns to his hometown of Seattle to host a radio talk show, but soon discovers he could use a shrink himself when his father moves in.

frasier.title: Space Quest
frasier.description: Fed up with a lack of privacy at home and at work, Frasier decides it's time for his father to move out.

frasier.title: Dinner at Eight
frasier.description: It's a culinary culture clash when Frasier and Niles join their father for dinner at his favorite restaurant.

frasier.title: I Hate Frasier Crane
frasier.description: After trading barbs with a newspaper columnist, Frasier rises to the challenge of a fist fight.

frasier.title: Here's Looking at You
frasier.description: Frasier plays matchmaker for his father and the eligible bachelorette Martin spied through his telescope.

frasier.title: The Crucible
frasier.description: Frasier is furious when he learns that his newest art purchase is actually a fake.

frasier.title: Call Me Irresponsible
frasier.description: Frasier faces a personal and professional dilemma when he begins dating the ex-girlfriend of one of his radio show callers.

frasier.title: Beloved Infidel
frasier.description: When Frasier and Niles see their father dining with an old family friend, they conclude that Martin once had an affair with the woman.

frasier.title: Selling Out
frasier.description: When Frasier is lured into doing on-air endorsements, his professional credibility comes under fire.

frasier.title: Oops
frasier.description: When Frasier contributes to the rumor mill, he causes Bulldog to lose his job.

frasier.title: Death Becomes Him
frasier.description: When a seemingly healthy colleague dies unexpectedly, Frasier becomes obsessed with his own mortality.

frasier.title: Miracle on Third or Fourth Street
frasier.description: When his son cannot spend the holidays with him, a melancholy Frasier learns the true spirit of Christmas from a group of strangers.

frasier.title: Guess Who's Coming To Breakfast?
frasier.description: Martin is furious with Frasier when he spills the secrets of his father's love life on the air.

frasier.title: Can't Buy Me Love
frasier.description: Frasier looks forward to a hot date with a beautiful model who "bought" him in a celebrity bachelor auction.

frasier.title: You Can't Tell a Crook by His Cover
frasier.description: After Frasier claims he can spot a criminal in a crowd, Martin challenges him to identify the ex-con in his poker group.

frasier.title: The Show Where Lilith Comes Back
frasier.description: After finding a long-lost letter of reconciliation from Frasier, Lilith comes to Seattle and tries to rekindle their relationship.

frasier.title: A Midwinter Night's Dream
frasier.description: Niles faces the ultimate temptation when he and Daphne are trapped in his home during a violent storm.

frasier.title: And the Whimper is...
frasier.description: When Frasier's show is nominated for a local broadcasting award, Roz suggests they "persuade" the judges by plying them with gifts.

frasier.title: Give Him the Chair!
frasier.description: Frasier learns that sentiment is more important than style after he accidentally loses his father's old armchair.

frasier.title: Fortysomething
frasier.description: Panicked at the prospect of growing old, Frasier seeks solace in the pursuit of a pretty young woman who shows an interest in him.

frasier.title: Travels with Martin
frasier.description: Frasier's attempts at a father-son vacation turn into an outrageous road trip, with Niles and Daphne along for the ride.

frasier.title: Author, Author
frasier.description: Sibling rivalry flares when Frasier and Niles decide to collaborate on a self-help book.

frasier.title: Frasier Crane's Day Off
frasier.description: While home sick with the flu, Frasier becomes paranoid that everyone, including his own brother Niles, is out to take over his show.

frasier.title: My Coffee with Niles
frasier.description: When Niles asks Frasier if he's happy after his first year back in Seattle, the question opens up a comical and revealing family dialogue.

frasier.title: Slow Tango in South Seattle
frasier.description: Frasier discovers that a steamy best seller was based on his affair with an older woman.

frasier.title: The Unkindest Cut of All
frasier.description: After Eddie fathers a litter of illegitimate pups, Frasier goes behind Martin's back to get the dog neutered.

frasier.title: The Matchmaker
frasier.description: Frasier's plan to "fix up" Daphne with his new boss goes awry when Frasier learns his secret.

frasier.title: Flour Child
frasier.description: After witnessing a woman give birth, Niles decides it's time to practice his parenting skills -- on a sack of flour!

frasier.title: Duke's We Hardly Knew Ye'
frasier.description: Frasier and Niles are upset when they learn that they're investors in the company slated to demolish their father's favorite hangout.

frasier.title: The Botched Language of Cranes
frasier.description: Frasier endures the wrath of Seattle residents after he "slams" the city in an on- air tirade.

frasier.title: The Candidate
frasier.description: Frasier agrees to make a television commercial for his candidate of choice in a local election, only to learn some very distressing information moments before they film.

frasier.title: Adventures in Paradise (1)
frasier.description: Frasier's budding relationship is put to the test when he bumps into his ex-wife Lilith while on vacation with his new love.

frasier.title: Adventures in Paradise (2)
frasier.description: Jealousy rears its ugly head when Frasier bumps into Lilith and her new boyfriend while vacationing with his new girlfriend.

frasier.title: Burying a Grudge
frasier.description: Martin finds it hard to "forgive and forget" when he runs into a former police buddy who's in the hospital.

frasier.title: Seat of Power
frasier.description: Frasier and Niles confront the bullies who used to torment them in junior high school.

frasier.title: Roz in the Doghouse
frasier.description: Roz and Frasier discover that breaking up is hard to do after Roz takes a new job as Bulldog's producer.

frasier.title: Retirement Is Murder
frasier.description: Frasier plays amateur sleuth after becoming caught up in Martin's obsession with a twenty-year-old unsolved murder.

frasier.title: Fool Me Once, Shame on You, Fool Me Twice...
frasier.description: After a thief steals Frasier's briefcase and his car, Frasier sets a trap to catch him in the act.

frasier.title: You Scratch My Book...
frasier.description: Frasier falls for a pop psychologist whose stunning beauty blinds him to the fact that he doesn't respect her "New Age" beliefs.

frasier.title: The Show Where Sam Shows Up
frasier.description: Frasier receives a surprise visit from his Boston buddy Sam Malone, who just left his girlfriend standing at the altar.

frasier.title: Daphne's Room
frasier.description: When Frasier's caught in Daphne's room, his attempts to rectify the invasion of her privacy only make the situation worse.

frasier.title: The Club
frasier.description: Niles and Frasier sabotage each other's chances for acceptance into Seattle's prestigious Empire Club.

frasier.title: Someone to Watch over Me
frasier.description: The attentiveness of an overzealous fan leads Frasier to fear that he's the object of an obsessed stalker

frasier.title: Breaking the Ice
frasier.description: Stranded for the night in an old ice fishing shack, Frasier confronts his father's inability to say "I love you" to his sons.

frasier.title: An Affair to Forget
frasier.description: Frasier learns that Niles's wife may be having an affair with her fencing instructor

frasier.title: Agents in America, Part III
frasier.description: Frasier's tough-as-nails agent uses extreme measures to renegotiate his contract with the radio station.

frasier.title: The Innkeepers
frasier.description: On a whim, Frasier and Niles decide to buy one of Seattle's oldest and finest restaurants.

frasier.title: Dark Victory
frasier.description: Martin's birthday brings Frasier's friends and family together, but Frasier soon finds himself mediating evervone's problems

frasier.title: She's the Boss
frasier.description: When Frasier refuses to change his show to suit his new female boss, she banishes him to the "graveyard" shift.

frasier.title: Shrink Rap
frasier.description: A psychotherapy partnership between Frasier and Niles brings out the worst in their relationship.

frasier.title: Martin Does It His Way
frasier.description: The death of Frasier's great aunt inspires Martin to pursue his lifelong dream of writing a song for Frank Sinatra.

frasier.title: Leapin' Lizards
frasier.description: Frasier decides to retaliate against Bulldog's childish pranks with a trick of his own, which winds up putting the new station manager in the hospital.

frasier.title: Kisses Sweeter Than Wine
frasier.description: While Frasier frantically prepares to host an important party, Niles tries to dissuade Daphne from pursuing a romance with Frasier's contractor.

frasier.title: Sleeping with the Enemy (1)
frasier.description: Labor relations go from heated to hot and heavy when Frasier and his boss negotiate a staff raise -- and an unexpected passion for each other.

frasier.title: The Adventures of Bad Boy and Dirty Girl (2)
frasier.description: Frasier and Kate vow to end their office romance, but can't seem to keep their hands off each other!

frasier.title: The Last Time I Saw Maris
frasier.description: Niles follows Frasier's advice to stand up to Maris, but she responds by asking for a divorce.

frasier.title: Frasier Grinch
frasier.description: Frasier's thrilled by the prospect of a Christmas visit from his son, but he's forced to brave the mall on Christmas Eve to find just the right gift.

frasier.title: It's Hard to Say Goodbye If You Won't Leave
frasier.description: Frasier realizes he has strong feelings for Kate, just when she announces that she's relocating to Chicago.

frasier.title: The Friend
frasier.description: Frasier befriends Bob, a wheelchair-bound man whom he doesn't have the heart to "dump" after he discovers they have nothing in common.

frasier.title: Come Lie with Me
frasier.description: Frasier is uncomfortable when Daphne's boyfriend spends the night in her room, but soon finds he's even more uncomfortable with the prospect of Daphne moving out.

frasier.title: Moon Dance
frasier.description: Realizing that it's time he started dating again, Niles takes Daphne to a society ball.

frasier.title: The Show Where Diane Comes Back
frasier.description: The arrival of Diane Chambers in Seattle puts Frasier on an emotional roller coaster ride.

frasier.title: A Word to the Wiseguy
frasier.description: When Maris gets in trouble with the law, Niles seeks the help of a shady character who will solve the problem in return for a "favor."

frasier.title: Look Before You Leap
frasier.description: In honor of Leap Year, Frasier urges his friends and family members to try something daring, but their own "leaps" don't turn out as expected.

frasier.title: High Crane Drifter
frasier.description: Much to his chagrin, Frasier becomes a local hero after he physically assaults a rude customer at Cafe Nervosa.

frasier.title: Chess Pains
frasier.description: Frasier challenges his father to a game of chess, but when Martin wins, Frasier becomes obsessed with beating him.

frasier.title: Crane vs. Crane
frasier.description: Frasier and Niles square off in a court battle over the competency of an eccentric millionaire.

frasier.title: Police Story
frasier.description: Frasier sets his sights on a female police officer who actually has a crush on his father.

frasier.title: Where There's Smoke There's Fired
frasier.description: The new station owner asks Frasier to help his fiancee stop smoking, but Frasier panics when he realizes who his "patient" is.

frasier.title: Frasier Loves Roz
frasier.description: Roz mistakenly thinks Frasier is in love with her when he tries to break up her new relationship.

frasier.title: The Focus Group
frasier.description: When Frasier learns that one member of a focus group doesn't like his show, he stops at nothing to find out the reason.

frasier.title: You Can Go Home Again
frasier.description: Listening to a tape of his very first radio show sends Frasier on a somewhat uncomfortable trip down Memory Lane.

frasier.title: The Two Mrs. Cranes
frasier.description: The Crane household is turned upside down when Daphne's old flame comes to town.

frasier.title: Love Bites Dog
frasier.description: When Roz sets Frasier up on a blind date, Bulldog winds up falling for her instead.

frasier.title: The Impossible Dream
frasier.description: When Frasier is awakened night after night by a recurring dream, he becomes obsessed with analyzing the psychological meaning behind it.

frasier.title: A Crane's Critique
frasier.description: After Martin befriends a reclusive writer both Frasier and Niles admire, they become obsessed with reading the author's first manuscript in decades.

frasier.title: Head Game
frasier.description: While filling in for Frasier, Niles gains fame after counseling a local basketball star who's in a slump.

frasier.title: Mixed Doubles
frasier.description: After Daphne gets dumped by her boyfriend, Niles decides it's time to declare his love for her.

frasier.title: A Lilith Thanksgiving
frasier.description: Frasier and Lilith join forces so that their son can gain admission to the most prestigious private school in Boston.

frasier.title: Our Father Whose Art Ain't Heaven
frasier.description: Martin buys Frasier an expensive painting -- but Frasier doesn't have the heart to tell his father that he hates it.

frasier.title: Dad Loves Sherry, the Boys Just Whine
frasier.description: Frasier and Niles disapprove of Martin's relationship with his brassy new girlfriend.

frasier.title: Liar! Liar!
frasier.description: Frasier finds himself in a precarious position when he tries to help the troubled marriage of a former high school acquaintance.

frasier.title: Three Days of the Condo
frasier.description: When Frasier becomes fed up with the rules and regulations governing his condominium complex, he decides to run for condo board president.

frasier.title: Death and the Dog
frasier.description: Eddie feels blue, so Martin hires a dog psychiatrist to determine the cause of his depression.

frasier.title: Four for the Seesaw
frasier.description: When the Crane brothers go away for the weekend with two attractive women, Niles discovers he hasn't quite cut his emotional ties to Maris.

frasier.title: To Kill a Talking Bird
frasier.description: Niles moves into a prestigious building and tries to impress his snobby neighbors with an elegant dinner party.

frasier.title: Roz's Krantz & Gouldenstein Are Dead
frasier.description: While volunteering at a retirement home, Roz becomes convinced that she's "the angel of death" after her first two patients die on her.

frasier.title: The Unnatural
frasier.description: Rather than show his son that his dad's not perfect, Frasier agrees to join the station's softball team -- even though he has no idea how to play the game.

frasier.title: Roz's Turn
frasier.description: When an on-air hosting spot opens up at the station, Roz decides to go for it -- but Frasier's agent has other ideas.

frasier.title: Ham Radio
frasier.description: Frasier's attempts to produce a live, 1940s-style radio drama for the station's fiftieth anniversary produce chaos instead.

frasier.title: Three Dates and a Breakup (1)
frasier.description: While Frasier tries to juggle three dates in three days, Martin and his girlfriend face the prospect of breaking up.

frasier.title: Three Dates and a Breakup (2)
frasier.description: Frasier tries to get Martin and Sherry to reconcile -- to the detriment of his own love life.

frasier.title: Daphne Hates Sherry
frasier.description: Frasier and Niles are caught in the middle when Martin's girlfriend and Daphne can't stop bickering.

frasier.title: Are You Being Served?
frasier.description: Frasier tries to console Niles after Maris serves him with divorce papers.

frasier.title: Ask Me No Questions
frasier.description: When Niles asks Frasier whether he and Maris belong together, Frasier goes out of his way to give his brother an honest, thoughtful response.

frasier.title: Odd Man Out
frasier.description: Frasier comes down with a case of the "bachelor blues" when he realizes that every single person he knows is dating someone -- except him.

frasier.title: Frasier's Imaginary Friend
frasier.description: Nobody believes Frasier when he claims to be dating a famous supermodel.

frasier.title: The Gift Horse
frasier.description: The sibling rivalry between Frasier and Niles reaches a fever pitch when they try and "top" each other's 65th birthday gift to their father, Martin.

frasier.title: Halloween
frasier.description: Niles' Halloween costume party becomes a comedy of errors when he mistakenly thinks that Daphne is pregnant -- and Frasier's the father.

frasier.title: The Kid
frasier.description: Frasier is stunned when he learns the true identity of the man who is the father of Roz's baby.

frasier.title: The 1000th Show
frasier.description: Niles' envy and a series of mishaps may prevent Frasier from attending the festivities honoring him for his 1,000th radio show.

frasier.title: Voyage of the Damned
frasier.description: To take Niles' mind off his marital problems, Frasier invites him on an Alasakan cruise -- but neglects to tell Niles he's also invited Maris as a "surprise."

frasier.title: My Fair Frasier
frasier.description: Frasier falls for a high-powered lawyer, whose successful career and takecharge attitude turns Frasier into a "wimp."

frasier.title: Desperately Seeking Closure
frasier.description: When, Frasier gets "dumped" by his high-powered girlfriend Sam, he makes a fool of himself trying to win her back.

frasier.title: Perspectives on Christmas
frasier.description: It's a Christmas to remember when Martin sings in a church pageant, Niles gets stuck in an elevator, and Frasier spills the beans about Roz's pregnancy to her unsuspecting mother.

frasier.title: Where Every Bloke Knows Your Name
frasier.description: Daphne's attempts to lift Frasier's spirits by taking him to her favorite British pub backfires when Frasier decides to become a regular at "her" hangout.

frasier.title: Ain't Nobody's Business if 'I Do'
frasier.description: The discovery of an engagement ring hidden in their father's drawer leads Niles and Frasier to investigate Sherry's checkered past before Martin has a chance to "pop the question."

frasier.title: The Zoo Story
frasier.description: Fed up with his cutthroat agent Bebe, Frasier soon learns the high price of hiring a "nice" agent to represent him in contract negotiations.

frasier.title: The Maris Counselor
frasier.description: Niles is shocked to discover that his trusted marriage counselor and Maris are having a torrid affair behind his back.

frasier.title: The Ski Lodge
frasier.description: A weekend ski trip snowballs into a hotbed of romantic antics for Frasier, Niles and their friends.

frasier.title: Room Service
frasier.description: An unexpected visit from Lilith stirs old passions in Frasier and new ones in Niles.

frasier.title: Beware of Greeks
frasier.description: Sparks fly when a family wedding re-ignites a long-simmering feud between Frasier and his fiery Greek Aunt Zora.

frasier.title: The Perfect Guy
frasier.description: The radio station hires a handsome new doctor to host a call-in medical show, but Frasier, nursing his male ego, is determined to find a flaw in his new colleague, who seems just a little "too perfect."

frasier.title: Bad Dog
frasier.description: When Bulldog wrongfully takes credit for foiling a robbery and saving Roz's life, Frasier becomes determined to make Bulldog "come clean."

frasier.title: Frasier Gotta Have It
frasier.description: Frasier's torn between his "lust" for his latest conquest and the realization that they have nothing in common.

frasier.title: First Date
frasier.description: Niles gets Daphne to help him plan a phony dinner date with a neighbor so she won't realize how much he really cares for her.

frasier.title: Roz and the Schnoz
frasier.description: Roz worries about the fate of her new baby when she discovers that the parents of her baby's father have two of the biggest noses she's ever seen.

frasier.title: The Life of the Party
frasier.description: Desperate to make a love connection, Frasier and Niles join forces to throw a singles party -- and end up vying for the affections of the same woman.

frasier.title: Party, Party
frasier.description: Frasier attempts to be in three places at once as he tries to keep his girlfriend, brother and dad happy.

frasier.title: Sweet Dreams
frasier.description: When Frasier leads a protest demanding better treatment of radio station employees, the head honcho at the station's parent company has another idea in mind.

frasier.title: Good Grief
frasier.description: When Frasier appears to be in denial over losing his job, Niles, Roz and Martin join forces to bring him back to reality.

frasier.title: Frasier's Curse
frasier.description: Frasier dreads the idea of attending his high school reunion, which always seems to coincide with a downturn in his life.

frasier.title: Dial M for Martin
frasier.description: Niles isn't too thrilled at the prospect of his father moving in - until he realizes that Daphne is part of the package.

frasier.title: Hot Ticket
frasier.description: Frasier and Niles will stop at nothing to get tickets to the hottest play in town.

frasier.title: First, Do No Harm
frasier.description: Frasier suspects that his gorgeous new girlfriend is just using him to get free psychiatric advice.

frasier.title: Secret Admirer
frasier.description: Mistakenly believing he's got a secret admirer, Frasier jeopardizes his new relationship by trying to double his pleasure.

frasier.title: How to Bury a Millionaire
frasier.description: After Maris freezes Niles' assets, he's forced to sublet his luxurious apartment and move into a "low-rent" complex.

frasier.title: The Seal Who Came to Dinner
frasier.description: Niles hosts a party at Maris' beach house in the hopes of winning his dinner club's prestigious 'Golden Apron' award. Niles panics when he discovers a very pungent--and very dead--seal on the beach.

frasier.title: Roz, a Loan
frasier.description: Frasier loans Roz $1,500 to tide her over until they get their jobs back, then disapproves of the way she spends the money.

frasier.title: Merry Christmas, Mrs. Moskowitz
frasier.description: Frasier is forced to feign Judaism when his girlfriend's Jewish mother visits. The charade is compounded by the apartment's holiday decor and Niles' participation in a Christmas pageant.

frasier.title: Good Samaritan
frasier.description: Frasier is the one who could use some help after his good deeds backfire on him.

frasier.title: Our Parents, Ourselves
frasier.description: Frasier and Roz play matchmakers for their parents - with disastrous results.

frasier.title: The Show where Woody Shows Up
frasier.description: Frasier's old friend from Boston, Woody, visits. The two have a great time reminiscing but as the week goes on, Frasier realizes they have nothing in common... and Woody won't leave.

frasier.title: Three Valentines
frasier.description: Valentine’s Day finds Niles, Frasier, Martin and Daphne on three very different kinds of dates.

frasier.title: To Tell the Truth
frasier.description: Niles hires an aggressive new divorce lawyer who may wind up exposing his long-running crush on Daphne.

frasier.title: Decoys
frasier.description: Niles secretly schemes to break up Daphne’s new romance with his divorce lawyer.

frasier.title: Dinner Party
frasier.description: Frasier’s plans for an elegant dinner party are thwarted at every turn.

frasier.title: Taps at the Montana
frasier.description: Facing eviction by his snooty tenants’ board, Niles throws a party in an effort to get back in their good graces.

frasier.title: IQ
frasier.description: The sibling rivalry between Frasier and Niles reaches a fever pitch when they compare IQ scores.

frasier.title: Dr. Nora
frasier.description: Frasier is horrified when the soft-spoken lady shrink he urged the station to hire turns out to be a tough-talking tyrant.

frasier.title: When a Man Loves Two Women
frasier.description: Frasier’s torn between dating his old girlfriend or a voluptuous new flame.

frasier.title: Visions of Daphne
frasier.description: To Niles’ delight, a series of psychic visions gives Daphne second thoughts about marrying Donny.

frasier.title: Shutout in Seattle (1)
frasier.description: Despondent over Daphne’s engagement, Niles takes a walk on the wild side with a funky waitress from Café Nervosa.

frasier.title: Shutout in Seattle (2)
frasier.description: The love lives of Frasier, Martin, Niles and Roz come crashing down around them.

frasier.title: Momma Mia
frasier.description: Frasier's new girlfriend is loving, attentive-and a dead ringer for his late mother.

frasier.title: Father of the Bride
frasier.description: Daphne is touched when Frasier agrees to pay for her wedding -- but aghast when he takes control of all the plans.

frasier.title: Radio Wars
frasier.description: Frasier vows revenge after a pair of radio "shock jocks" embarrass him in a series of on-air pranks.

frasier.title: Everyone's a Critic
frasier.description: Jealous of Niles' position as the arts critic for a snobby magazine, Frasier goes all out in his bid to host a cultural program on his radio station.

frasier.title: The Dog That Rocks the Cradle
frasier.description: Roz hires Bulldog to babysit her daughter, not realizing he's out to bulldoze her social life.

frasier.title: Rivals
frasier.description: Frasier and Niles crank their sibling rivalry up a notch when each believes the other is trying to steal his girlfriend.

frasier.title: A Tsar is Born
frasier.description: After a family heirloom is linked to the Romanoffs, Frasier and Niles giddily assume they are descended from royalty.

frasier.title: The Late Dr. Crane
frasier.description: An erroneous report that Frasier has died motivates him to do a makeover on his life.

frasier.title: The Apparent Trap
frasier.description: When Lilith visits Seattle over Thanksgiving, Frederick conspires to reunite his parents.

frasier.title: Back Talk (1)
frasier.description: Looped on pain medication for his ailing back, Frasier makes a startling announcement to Daphne.

frasier.title: The Fight Before Christmas (2)
frasier.description: Knowing Niles loves her, Daphne is forced to confront how she really feels about him.

frasier.title: RDWRER
frasier.description: After Frasier and Niles' New Year's plans fall through, they take a riotous road trip with Martin in his Winnebago.

frasier.title: They're Playing Our Song
frasier.description: Frasier's attempt to write a simple theme song for his show turns into a major production for he and Martin.

frasier.title: Big Crane on Campus
frasier.description: Frasier's "dream date" with a former prom queen turns out to be a living nightmare.

frasier.title: Out With Dad
frasier.description: Martin pretends he's gay to get out of dating a woman he doesn't find attractive.

frasier.title: Something About Dr. Mary
frasier.description: When Roz takes a vacation, Frasier's new call screener takes over Roz's job - and his show.

frasier.title: Whine Club
frasier.description: Frasier and Niles uncork a bad case of sibling rivalry when they compete for a prestigious position in their wine club.

frasier.title: Hot Pursuit
frasier.description: While Niles joins Martin on a stakeout, Roz and Frasier flirt with the idea of becoming more than just friends.

frasier.title: Morning Becomes Entertainment
frasier.description: Frasier checks his professional dignity at the door when he becomes the cohost of a mindless morning TV show with his agent, Bebe.

frasier.title: To Thine Old Self Be True
frasier.description: Frasier's budding romance is complicated by a stripper; Maris tries to sabotage Niles' new relationship.

frasier.title: Three Faces of Frasier
frasier.description: Frasier's delight at having his caricature displayed in a famous local landmark dissolves once he sees the unflattering portrait.

frasier.title: Dark Side of the Moon
frasier.description: The arrival of Daphne's obnoxious brother, Simon, unleashes an emotional torrent that drives her into therapy.

frasier.title: Something Borrowed, Someone Blue (1)
frasier.description: Just when Daphne decides to profess her love for Niles, he drops a stunning bombshell.

frasier.title: Something Borrowed, Someone Blue (2)
frasier.description: On the eve of her wedding, Daphne's torn between the man she loves and the man she's engaged to marry.

frasier.title: And the Dish Ran Away with the Spoon (1)
frasier.description: After running off together, Niles and Daphne face the wrath from their jilted lovers: Donny's suing for emotional distress and Mel's plotting a ruse.

frasier.title: And the Dish Ran Away with the Spoon (2)
frasier.description: Daphne considers dumping Niles after Donny and Mel's plotting stresses her out. Fortunately, Frasier comes to the lovers' aid once again.

frasier.title: The Bad Son
frasier.description: Frasier's disdain for public transportation takes a back seat to his fancy for a cute bus passenger; Daphne and Niles make a stargazing date only to end up star-crossed again.

frasier.title: The Great Crane Robbery
frasier.description: Frasier frets when his billionaire boss slavishly copies his aesthetic tastes, and Mel blackmails Niles into making a social faux pas.

frasier.title: Taking Liberties
frasier.description: Frasier hires a British butler whose proper presence only adds to the chaos in the Crane household. Meanwhile, Mel steps up her efforts to torment Niles.

frasier.title: Legal Tender Love and Care
frasier.description: Frasier hires a shady lady lawyer to defend him from a litigious Donny, who blames him for Daphne running out on their wedding.

frasier.title: The New Friend
frasier.description: Roz introduces Frasier to her new boyfriend, Luke, and the two men hit it off. When Roz and Luke break up, Frasier, hides his continuing friendship with him while supporting Roz during her heartbreak.

frasier.title: Mary Christmas
frasier.description: Frasier appears more jealous than jolly when he co-hosts Seattle's Christmas parade with his radio rival, Dr Mary; Niles and Daphne open their gifts early; and beer adds to Martin's holiday cheer.

frasier.title: Frasier's Edge
frasier.description: A lifetime achievement award sends Frasier into an existential crisis which culminates in a battle of wits with his old mentor; Daphne's weight gain doesn't go unnoticed.

frasier.title: Cranes Unplugged
frasier.description: Frasier gets a visit from his video-game obsessed son, Frederick; Daphne and Niles play Cupid for a lonely Roz.

frasier.title: Motor Skills
frasier.description: Frasier and Niles realize their helplessness when Frasier's car stalls, so they enrol in an auto repair night class. They quickly fall behind, and understand what it's like to be remedial students.

frasier.title: The Show Must Go Off
frasier.description: Frasier and Niles try to reawaken the career of Jackson Hedley, an old actor they saw perform Hamlet when they were young. When they see him perform again, however, they realize that he is talentless and will humiliate himself.

frasier.title: Sliding Frasiers
frasier.description: Frasier is supposed to go to a speed-dating event and asks Roz if he should wear a suit or sweater, remarking that the slightest decision can have far-reaching effects. We see what would have happened in each circumstance.

frasier.title: Hungry Heart
frasier.description: Kenny arrives at Frasier's place in a panic after unwittingly making a date with a woman even though he's married. Niles finally notices Daphne's weight gain.

frasier.title: Hooping Cranes
frasier.description: Frasier receives tickets to the Sonics game and goes with Martin and Niles. Niles is selected to attempt the halftime half-court shot, and miraculously makes it, drinking in the adoration of Martin and the rest of Seattle.

frasier.title: Docu Drama
frasier.description: Roz gets the green light to put on a special radio show about outer space, and agrees to let Frasier narrate. However, the two fail to come to grips with their reversed roles.

frasier.title: It Takes Two to Tangle
frasier.description: Frasier and Niles press Martin's rich girlfriend to save their bankrupt prep school.

frasier.title: Forgotten But Not Gone
frasier.description: Frasier leaves his wine club to host a new radio feature called "The Wine Corner" and is angered to learn that a resentful Niles - the club's overbearing "cork-master" has ordered it's old members not to participate in the program.

frasier.title: Daphne Returns
frasier.description: Niles and Daphne "get real" about their romance.

frasier.title: The Wizard and Roz
frasier.description: Daphne attempts to prove to Niles she has psychic visions and Frasier is ego-stricken when he discovers that Roz his having an affair with his mentor.

frasier.title: Semi-Decent Proposal (1)
frasier.description: Frasier runs into an old high school friend and has found love with her friend, Claire.

frasier.title: A Passing Fancy (2)
frasier.description: Frasier tutors Lana's son in exchange for a date with Claire. Martin goes to a dog party and Daphne and Niles have trouble sleeping in the same bed.

frasier.title: A Day in May
frasier.description: Niles gets jealous of an old flame of Daphne's at the dog park; Frasier teaches Lana about honesty in selling a problematic piece of real estate and Martin secretly attends the parole hearing of the man who shot him.

frasier.title: The Cranes Go Caribbean
frasier.description: Frasier's vacation plans with Claire turn disastrous when Daphne, Niles and Martin show up at the same resort and Frasier starts dreaming about Lana.

frasier.title: Don Juan in Hell (1)
frasier.description: Frasier continues to be conflicted about whether he truly wants to be with Lana instead of Claire. He consults his family, but a chance encounter at the airport steers him toward making a decision. Unfortunately, he may be too late.

frasier.title: Don Juan in Hell (2)
frasier.description: Troubled by his recent relationship woes, Frasier goes to the country for peace and quiet but ends up facing the ghosts of failed relationships past.

frasier.title: The First Temptation of Daphne
frasier.description: Daphne stumbles across a file of one of Niles' patients, who is in love with him via "transference." Daphne's paranoia sends her to extreme lengths to learn anything she can about the woman.

frasier.title: The Return of Martin Crane
frasier.description: Martin's new job triggers old memories.

frasier.title: Love Stinks
frasier.description: Frasier hosts a party for the staff at the radio station to improve his image.  Meanwhile, Roz dates a garbageman and Niles recalls his childhood memories with Daphne.

frasier.title: Room Full of Heroes
frasier.description: Frasier holds a 'Dress as Your Hero' Halloween party, but nobody can tell who he is.  Meanwhile, Niles dresses as Martin, Daphne as Elton John, Martin as Joe DiMaggio and Roz as Wonder Woman for the party.

frasier.title: Bla-Z-Boy
frasier.description: An accident causes a mess on Frasier's carpet and the destruction of Martin's chair.  Meanwhile, Niles gives piano lessons to talented Roz and not-so-talented Daphne.

frasier.title: The Two Hundredth Episode
frasier.description: Frasier has just completed his 2000th radio show, but discovers that one of the tapes of his collection of his broadcasts is missing. His quest to replace it borders on obsession, sending him spiralling into depression.

frasier.title: Sharing Kirby
frasier.description: Blood pressures and spirits rise as an intern becomes the pawn in Frasier and Niles' battle over a wine cellar tour.

frasier.title: Junior Agent
frasier.description: Frasier gets an annoying new agent in the middle of a competition between him and a rival radio broadcaster.

frasier.title: Bully for Martin
frasier.description: After Frasier witnesses Martin get chewed out by his boss, Frasier feels obligated to say something on his behalf. However, it only serves to make things worse.

frasier.title: Mother Load (1)
frasier.description: When Daphne and Niles decide to move in with each other, Daphne's mother and Simon arrive on a surprise visit.  Daphne and Niles decide to put off moving in together until her visiting relatives are gone.  Meanwhile, Frasier feuds with Cam Winston, his neighbor, over where Cam parks his large vehicle.

frasier.title: Mother Load (2)
frasier.description: Daphne and Niles continue to try and hide the fact that they have moved in with each other from Mrs. Moon.  She makes such a mess of things that the only way she will leave is if Simon takes care of her, but Simon has left for California.  Meanwhile, Frasier's neighbor Cam drapes the American flag over his balcony, and Frasier cannot complain because it would seem unpatriotic.

frasier.title: Juvenilia
frasier.description: Kenny tells Frasier and Roz that some recent research into KACL listeners shows that Frasier's average listener is an older gentleman who keeps the radio on for company. He suggests Frasier reach out to the youth.

frasier.title: The Proposal
frasier.description: Niles plans on proposing to Daphne, so he prepares his speech; buys a ring; and hires a choir, a string quartet, a trumpet player and Wolfgang Puck.  But Daphne's mother is still staying with them, and on the night Niles plans to propose, Daphne begins to feel ill.

frasier.title: Wheels of Fortune
frasier.description: Frasier is unimpressed when his scheming, scamming ex-brother-in-law rolls in for a visit -- now in a wheelchair -- and claims to be a reformed, God-fearing man who needs money for a revival ministry.

frasier.title: Three Blind Dates
frasier.description: Niles sets Frasier up with Lisa, a patient who owns a bookstore, but they never run into each other.  Roz sets Frasier up with Suzanne, an artist, who ends up hating Frasier.  Martin sets Frasier up with Kris, an attractive girl from his building, who seems to know every man at the bar.  But Frasier later runs into and hits it off with Lisa.

frasier.title: War of the Words
frasier.description: A-N-X-I-E-T-Y seizes Frasier at the National Spelling Bee, where his son Frederick is a leading competitor.

frasier.title: Deathtrap
frasier.description: While Frasier and Niles uncover a human skull under the floor of their childhood home and let their imagination get the better of them, Roz's daughter's hamster has died and she is uncertain how to break it to her.

frasier.title: The Love You Fake
frasier.description: To quell a feud between Frasier and an upstairs antagonist, Martin and the neighbor's mother feign a romance.

frasier.title: Cheerful Goodbyes
frasier.description: Frasier returns to Boston to give a speech, and Niles, Daphne and Martin tag along to see the city. Once there, Frasier runs into Cliff Clavin.

frasier.title: Frasier Has Spokane
frasier.description: Frasier's show has branched out to Spokane, and he goes to the station in Spokane to meet the press. He quickly finds out that the press and his callers refuse to warm up to him.

frasier.title: The Guilt Trippers
frasier.description: Guilt feelings over a sexual liaison with Roz plague Frasier, who heads out to her family reunion in Wisconsin to make amends.

frasier.title: Moons Over Seattle
frasier.description: Niles' persistence finally convinces Daphne's father to come to Seattle to reconcile with his wife. Daphne is disappointed that Niles didn't consult her first, but is on board with the plan.

frasier.title: The Ring Cycle
frasier.description: After Daphne and Niles elope in Reno, they are forced to go through several fake ceremonies in not to upset friends and family who wanted to be at the wedding.

frasier.title: Enemy at the Gate
frasier.description: Frasier drives Niles back from a shopping excursion. Just as they enter the parking garage, Frasier suddenly realizes that the clock in his car is incorrect and that he is going to be late for his show.

frasier.title: Proxy Prexy
frasier.description: Frasier is desperate to finally win the presidency of the condo board after several unsuccessful attempts.  However, he admits that he has no chance because he has rubbed all of the board members the wrong way at one time or another.

frasier.title: Kissing Cousin
frasier.description: Frasier is surprised to learn that Kenny has never unpacked the boxes in his office because he views all of his jobs as temporary.  Roz's younger cousin Jen comes to stay with her for the week.  She is extremely cynical and opinionated, and quickly gets on Frasier's nerves.

frasier.title: Tales from the Crypt
frasier.description: Frasier is infuriated when Bulldog successfully pulls several practical jokes on him.  He vows to get revenge, and plots an elaborate prank that he takes way too seriously.  Martin and Roz predict that he will fail because he is terrible at carrying out pranks.  .

frasier.title: Star Mitzvah
frasier.description: As Frasier prepares for Frederick's bar mitzvah, Noel offers to translate Frasier's speech into Hebrew in exchange for an autograph from a science fiction convention.  However, when Frasier doesn't keep his end of the bargain, Noel uses his wealth of Star Trek knowledge to take revenge.

frasier.title: Bristle While You Work (1)
frasier.description: Niles becomes concerned about a lingering toothache after his dentist assures him that there is nothing wrong with the tooth.  He tells Roz that there is a chance that he may be suffering from referred pain; and that the pain could actually be a sign of a heart condition.

frasier.title: Rooms With a View (2)
frasier.description: Niles prepares to undergo heart bypass surgery.  He is surprised to receive a call wishing him well from Maris, who had learned of his plight from a gossipy acquaintance.  Frasier tries to keep Roz and the family at ease by researching the procedure (as well as the doctors' backgrounds) and printing out detailed descriptions for everyone.

frasier.title: Don't Go Breaking My Heart (3)
frasier.description: Niles recovers rapidly from his heart surgery and receives the go-ahead from doctors to resume normal activities, but seems reluctant to do this.  He maintains his strict post-operative diet, and refuses to exercise or share a bed with Daphne.

frasier.title: We Two Kings
frasier.description: Frasier and Niles bicker over who gets to host the family Christmas celebration. When it seems that Martin will have to work, they decide to bring Christmas to him, with disastrous results. Meanwhile, Roz finds herself attracted to a hunky shopping mall Santa.

frasier.title: Door Jam
frasier.description: Frasier mistakenly receives some of Cam Winston's mail, including a mysterious invitation to an exclusive locale.  Frasier and Niles are surprised to have been left out of the loop about this new hot spot, and become obsessed with finding out more information.

frasier.title: The Harassed
frasier.description: Frasier is forced to give up ten minutes of his show for a new financial analysis segment. When the beautiful new stock market reporter's attitude rubs everyone the wrong way, Frasier misreads her signals, which lands everyone in a sexual harassment seminar.

frasier.title: Lilith Needs a Favor
frasier.description: Lilith comes to Seattle, and tells Frasier that she would like to have another child.  She wants him to father the child through artificial insemination so that Frederick could have a full-sibling.  Frasier is hesitant to go along with this, so Lilith tries to manipulate him by bringing up touching stories from Frederick's childhood.

frasier.title: Daphne Does Dinner
frasier.description: Niles and Frasier plan a party to celebrate the unveiling of a painting that Niles has just purchased.  However, Daphne notes that every event the brothers host inevitably ends in disaster.

frasier.title: Trophy Girlfriend
frasier.description: Tired of being humiliated in his club's annual squash tournament, Niles ditches Frasier and pairs with a younger partner.  A P.E. teacher named Chelsea asks Frasier to team with her in the mixed doubles competition.

frasier.title: Fraternal Schwinns
frasier.description: KACL organizes a bike-a-thon to raise money for AIDS research.  Frasier plans to just make a financial donation, but is goaded into participating after Julia announces her intention to take part.  Daphne suggests that she and Niles also enter the event.

frasier.title: Kenny on the Couch
frasier.description: Kenny becomes extremely depressed after his divorce is finalized.  Frasier offers to refer him to another psychiatrist, but Kenny says that he would prefer to discuss his problems with Frasier.

frasier.title: Roe to Perdition
frasier.description: Frasier and Niles become a big hit when, at a party, they serve beluga caviar they purchased on the black market. Meanwhile, Martin has a tough time returning $40 an ATM gave him in error.

frasier.title: Some Assembly Required
frasier.description: Frasier's co-workers cajole him into helping them build a house for Habitat for Humanity.  Frasier mostly seems to get in the way, and his participation is limited to stirring paint and a little bit of sanding.

frasier.title: Farewell, Nervosa
frasier.description: Frasier consults his old friend Avery for advice on his finances.  Avery says that Frasier's spending habits are out of control.  Frasier becomes depressed and heads out to Cafe Nervosa to think about a solution.

frasier.title: The Devil and Dr. Phil
frasier.description: Frasier learns that Dr. Phil McGraw is in town for a special.  The two are old friends, but Frasier is angry at Phil for supposedly swindling him out of $200 in a poker game.  He reluctantly agrees to take the star-struck Roz to the set to see him.

frasier.title: Fathers and Sons
frasier.description: Leland Barton, Hester's former research assistant, comes for a visit after a long absence from Seattle.  Roz becomes alarmed when Leland confesses his deep affection for Hester.

frasier.title: Analyzed Kiss
frasier.description: Julia becomes extremely depressed after breaking up with Avery, who had never followed through on his promise to leave his wife for her.  He tries to deny her the credit for their software company, an endeavor for which she did most of the work.

frasier.title: A New Position for Roz
frasier.description: Roz tries to train the woefully incompetent Noel as Frasier's new producer as she prepares to leave KACL.  She becomes increasingly melancholy about the possibility of leaving Frasier, and bristles upon learning of his new relationship with Julia.

frasier.title: No Sex, Please, We're Skittish
frasier.description: Roz's return to KACL rattles Frasier, who's reinvolved with Julia; Niles' fatherhood plans get an unexpected setback he determines to remedy with an unorthodox virility enhancer.

frasier.title: A Man, a Plan and a Gal: Julia
frasier.description: Love blinds Frasier to the faults of Julia, who behaves obnoxiously and insensitively at a Crane dinner gathering. For starters, she embarrasses Daphne, then winds up chattering incessantly on her cell phone.

frasier.title: The Doctor Is Out
frasier.description: Frasier and Niles suspect that Roz's new boyfriend, Barry, is gay.  They see Barry on the street and believe that he has gone into a gay bar.  Frasier, worried that Barry is leading Roz on, goes inside to confront him.

frasier.title: The Babysitter
frasier.description: A courtship makes rivals of Martin and Frasier, who are vying for the affections of the latter's former baby-sitter, now a lounge singer with a vivacious personality and a quick wit that's appealing to both Crane senior and junior.

frasier.title: The Placeholder
frasier.description: Roz tries to convince Frasier to go out with her friend Ann.  She feels that Frasier is too particular about who he dates, and adds that there is nothing wrong with continuing to date around until the right person comes along.

frasier.title: I'm Listening
frasier.description: Frasier overhears Ronee making a date with another man.  He tells Martin, who is furious at him for eavesdropping.  Ronee later breaks the news to Martin herself, explaining that she didn't think they had an exclusive relationship.

frasier.title: Maris Returns (1)
frasier.description: Niles receives a phone call from a panicked Maris, who asks to meet him for lunch.  She asks for advice on how to handle her violent, philandering lover.  Niles recommends that she leave him immediately.

frasier.title: Murder Most Maris (2)
frasier.description: Niles is questioned by the police because he loaned Maris the murder weapon--an antique crossbow--for use in a play.  Maris insists that she acted in self-defense.  She continually calls Niles from jail, leaving Daphne extremely angry.

frasier.title: Guns N' Neuroses
frasier.description: Lilith comes to town for a one-day conference.  She and Frasier try to get together, but keep having to cancel.  Lilith discusses her romantic problems with a colleague at Cafe Nervosa before having to return to the conference.

frasier.title: Seabee Jeebies
frasier.description: Niles gains notoriety throughout Seattle because of his involvement in Maris's murder case.  He and Daphne mingle with the city's social elite (including Bill Gates), and he is able to finagle reservations at booked restaurants.

frasier.title: High Holidays
frasier.description: Frasier is shocked when Frederick comes to visit sporting his new 'goth' look.  Meanwhile, realising that he never rebelled in his adolescence, Niles decides to try marijuana...with unexpected results.

frasier.title: Frasier-Lite
frasier.description: Weight loss challenges KACL, enrolled in a pound-shedding contest that pits Frasier against a taunting nemesis who bullied him in high school.

frasier.title: The Ann Who Came To Dinner
frasier.description: Lawsuit fears plague Frasier over an accident in his kitchen that befell his insurer: a former date named Ann he snubbed. Now, Frasier entreats her to recuperate at his place, where Ann takes full advantage of the situation.

frasier.title: Freudian Sleep
frasier.description: Strange dreams dominate this episode, which finds Frasier wed to Daphne, now a vociferous eater; Niles a carefree philanderer, dallying with bikini-clad repairwomen; and Martin a dashing hoofer, performing with Ronee.

frasier.title: Caught in the Act
frasier.description: Roz is disappointed when she is unable to get Alice tickets to a concert by children's performer Nanny G.  After his family reveals that he used to be married to her, Frasier agrees to help Roz secure tickets.

frasier.title: Boo!
frasier.description: A practical joke backfires, giving Martin a 'mild cardiac event' that he's anxious to keep secret from Ronee, fearing that she'll think he's become 'some feeble old guy'.

frasier.title: Coots and Ladders
frasier.description: Guilty feelings seize Frasier, who, just for a thrill, swipes a medallion from his neighbor, a chatty, trusting widow. Now he sets out to secretly return the object, with the reluctant help of Niles.

frasier.title: Match Game
frasier.description: Lovelorn Frasier engages a matchmaker, who mismatches him with dinner dates that turn disastrous; well-meaning Niles hires a kooky helpmate for Daphne's delivery who works with a shaman ...and a drummer.

frasier.title: Miss Right Now
frasier.description: Martin worries about a visit from Ronee's mother.  She dislikes him because she once saw Martin innocently comforting the teenage Ronee and assumed he was trying to 'take her virtue'.

frasier.title: And Frasier Makes Three
frasier.description: Courting unnerves Frasier, whose wooing of a winsome matchmaker is constantly interrupted by her disarming beau, a dedicated environmentalist who's also quite cosmopolitan.

frasier.title: Detour
frasier.description: Country ways test Frasier and Charlotte, who're stranded at a farmhouse with a very odd family that has no idea who he is. Back home, a physical therapist is mistaken for a stripper in a situation that greatly embarrasses Niles.

frasier.title: Crock Tales
frasier.description: As Frasier prepares for a dinner party, he considers throwing away an old broken crock pot.  However, the crock pot stirs many memories of past experiences with his friends and family.

frasier.title: Goodnight, Seattle (1)
frasier.description: During an especially bumpy flight Frasier tells a fellow passenger about his eventful past few weeks which are recounted in a long flashback. Bebe tells Frasier that he has been offered the chance to replace a recently deceased San Francisco radio host.

frasier.title: Goodnight, Seattle (2)
frasier.description: Daphne gives birth to a healthy son David. Frasier marries Martin and Ronee in the vet's office before Daphne and the baby leave for the hospital. Frasier grows very lonely with Martin out of the apartment and Daphne and Niles busy with their son.

community.title: Pilot
community.description: When the legitimacy of his degree is challenged, lawyer Jeff Winger must return to school, where he meets a clan of misfit community college students.

community.title: Spanish 101
community.description: While Jeff looks to use a Spanish class assignment to get close to Britta, Pierce has something altogether different in mind.

community.title: Introduction to Film
community.description: Jeff struggles to get a good grade, and Britta's offer to bankroll his film class exposes a rift between Abed and his angry father.

community.title: Social Psychology
community.description: As Annie recruits Abed and Troy for a psychology class experiment, Jeff and Shirley bond over their mutual fondness for gossip.

community.title: Advanced Criminal Law
community.description: As Pierce volunteers to compose a new school song, a cheating episode in Spanish class leaves Jeff defending Britta before a disciplinary tribunal.

community.title: Football, Feminism and You
community.description: Annie's dream of being the ex-football star's girlfriend is in jeopardy when Jeff is blackmailed into getting Troy to join Greendale's football team.

community.title: Introduction to Statistics
community.description: Jeff sets his sights on an attractive professor, and Annie looks to boost her social standing by hosting a Day of the Dead party.

community.title: Home Economics
community.description: Jeff is forced out of his condo and into Abed's dorm room, and Annie looks to get Troy's attention by helping him plan a romantic picnic.

community.title: Debate 109
community.description: As Jeff is drafted to help lead Greendale's debate team against the formidable City College, Abed's film-class projects appear to predict the future.

community.title: Environmental Science
community.description: Faced with an unreasonable amount of Spanish homework, Jeff's efforts to handle Señor Chang manage to help him, but not the rest of the class.

community.title: The Politics of Human Sexuality
community.description: With his high-price "escort" girlfriend on his arm, Pierce pressures Jeff into asking Dean Pelton's airhead secretary to double date at the STD Fair.

community.title: Comparative Religion
community.description: Shirley's plans for a holiday party are in jeopardy when Jeff is drawn into a fight with a campus bully.

community.title: Investigative Journalism
community.description: Jeff accepts an invitation to be the editor of the school paper as he and his friends fend off an interloper who wants to join their study group.

community.title: Interpretive Dance
community.description: As Jeff and Prof. Slater try to keep their student-teacher romance under wraps, Britta and Troy tell everyone about their shared passion for dance.

community.title: Romantic Expressionism
community.description: Jeff and Britta team up to derail Annie's fledgling romance with Greendale's resident hippie singer-songwriter, Vaughn.

community.title: Communication Studies
community.description: As Valentine's Day finds Jeff struggling with his feelings for Britta and Professor Slater, Pierce and Troy are wrongly blamed for a prank.

community.title: Physical Education
community.description: The study group helps Abed land a date with a girl, and Jeff squares off with a P.E. coach who insists that he wear gym shorts to a billiards class.

community.title: Basic Genealogy
community.description: As Family Day lands Jeff in the middle of an affair with Pierce's sexy ex-stepdaughter, Shirley's unruly sons help liberate Abed's Afghani cousin.

community.title: Beginner Pottery
community.description: A pottery class he takes for an easy A reveals Jeff's deep-seated need to succeed.

community.title: The Science of Illusion
community.description: When her April Fools' Day prank inadvertently sends a human cadaver out the anatomy lab window, Britta looks to place the blame on Jeff.

community.title: Contemporary American Poultry
community.description: A scheme to replace a corrupt cafeteria employee transforms the study group into a criminal gang run by a power-hungry Abed.

community.title: The Art of Discourse
community.description: While a tasteless prank ends with Pierce being tossed out of the group, Britta and Jeff are forced to team up against some teen newcomers at school.

community.title: Modern Warfare
community.description: The first prize of priority registration engulfs Greendale Community College in a Spring Fling paintball war.

community.title: English as a Second Language
community.description: On the eve of an important final exam in Spanish, everyone's grades are jeopardized when it is discovered that Señor Chang has a damaging secret.

community.title: Pascal's Triangle Revisited
community.description: As the end of the school year finds Jeff at the apex of a romantic triangle, Annie ponders moving away with her hacky sack-playing boyfriend.

community.title: Anthropology 101
community.description: When the semester starts, Jeff is stunned that his rejection of Britta has made her a campus star; Chang wants to be accepted into the study group.

community.title: Accounting for Lawyers
community.description: When an old friend from Jeff's past appears unexpectedly, his friends discover that he was the one responsible for Jeff's disbarment.

community.title: The Psychology of Letting Go
community.description: A death provokes a fierce debate about Pierce's religious beliefs. Britta and Annie are at odds over tactics in the Gulf oil spill fund-raising drive.

community.title: Basic Rocket Science
community.description: Jeff and the group must salvage an aging museum exhibit that Dean Pelton wants as the centerpiece of Greendale's proposed aerospace training program.

community.title: Messianic Myths and Ancient Peoples
community.description: Shirley and Abed are at odds over his plan to direct and star in his own epic religious film.

community.title: Epidemiology
community.description: Dean Pelton's army surplus party food sparks an outbreak of zombie-ism at the Greendale Halloween party.

community.title: Aerodynamics of Gender
community.description: Abed endears himself to the girls after he offers to take down their enemies on campus; Jeff and Troy stumble onto a groundskeeper's secret paradise.

community.title: Cooperative Calligraphy
community.description: Annie's missing pen leads to friction within the group.

community.title: Conspiracy Theories and Interior Design
community.description: When Jeff tries to obtain credit for a fictitious class, the unintended consequences rock Greendale. Abed and Troy build an elaborate blanket fort.

community.title: Mixology Certification
community.description: Troy's friends help him celebrate his 21st birthday.

community.title: Abed's Uncontrollable Christmas
community.description: The meaning of Christmas is lost and Abed's intense fixation on the holiday concerns the group in this special stop-motion animation episode.

community.title: Asian Population Studies
community.description: With Chang pressing for membership in the study group, Annie's latest crush has Jeff reeling as Shirley unveils some stunning news.

community.title: Celebrity Pharmacology
community.description: Pierce's efforts to bribe director Annie may undermine the theater group's antidrug play; Jeff's texting prank puts Britta in an awkward situation.

community.title: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons
community.description: Abed invites "Fat Neil" to play a game of Dungeons & Dragons with the rest of the study group, hoping to boost his confidence, after Jeff becomes concerned about him being a loner. When Pierce finds out he was not invited, he joins anyway, disrupting their plans.

community.title: Early 21st Century Romanticism
community.description: On Valentine's Day, Troy and Abed compete for the attention of an assistant librarian, while Britta tries to show she's open-minded about lesbians.

community.title: Intermediate Documentary Filmmaking
community.description: Claiming that he is about to die, Pierce summons the study group to the hospital to bequeath his belongings to them.

community.title: Intro to Political Science
community.description: For an upcoming vice-presidential visit, Glendale's Dean Pelton hastily organizes an election for student body president that pits Annie against Jeff.

community.title: Custody Law and Eastern European Diplomacy
community.description: Although Shirley and Andre don't want Chang involved with her baby, he resolves to be a good dad. Abed and Troy's new friend may be a war criminal.

community.title: Critical Film Studies
community.description: Jeff and the group arrange a Pulp Fiction birthday party for Abed, but he has his own plans, starting with an expensive dinner for himself and Jeff.

community.title: Competitive Wine Tasting
community.description: Jeff is suspicious of Pierce's engagement to a pretty classmate. Troy invents a childhood trauma to impress Britta, and Abed challenges a professor.

community.title: Paradigms of Human Memory
community.description: Working on their final anthropology diorama, Chang finds a cache of items stolen by Troy's monkey that dredge up unhappy memories for the study group.

community.title: Applied Anthropology and Culinary Arts
community.description: As the semester ends, the anthropology final is disrupted when Shirley goes into labor and her husband, Andre, is summoned to school for the birth.

community.title: A Fistful of Paintballs (1)
community.description: A $100,000 paintball war prize pits members of the study group against one another, until they decide to join forces to stop a mysterious challenger.

community.title: For a Few Paintballs More (2)
community.description: As the paintball war is revealed to be a City College plot, Jeff and Troy vie for control of Greendale's ragtag army, while Pierce betrays the group.

community.title: Biology 101
community.description: As Jeff tries to keep Pierce from rejoining the study group, Dean Pelton faces off with Vice Dean Laybourne for control of Greendale.

community.title: Geography of Global Conflict
community.description: As Annie competes with an overachieving rival in a Model United Nations competition, Jeff wrestles with his feelings for his ambitious friend.

community.title: Competitive Ecology
community.description: The study group struggles to incorporate a fellow classmate while working on a project for Professor Kane's class.

community.title: Remedial Chaos Theory
community.description: When Jeff introduces an element of randomness into Troy and Abed's housewarming party, reality splits into six timelines.

community.title: Horror Fiction in Seven Spooky Steps
community.description: When a personality test suggests that one group member is a homicidal maniac, they use a series of scary Halloween stories to expose the killer.

community.title: Advanced Gay
community.description: When a drag queen's song makes Hawthorne Wipes an iconic gay product, Pierce embraces it, until his homophobic dad shows up to squelch the idea.

community.title: Studies in Modern Movement
community.description: Annie has second thoughts about moving in with Troy and Abed once she realizes that they expect her to live in a blanket fort.

community.title: Documentary Filmmaking: Redux
community.description: As Dean Pelton films a new commercial for Greendale, the production takes a wild turn once he discovers that a famous alum has agreed to appear in it.

community.title: Foosball and Nocturnal Vigilantism
community.description: When Shirley agrees to coach Jeff in foosball, they realize that she bullied him mercilessly when they were kids.

community.title: Regional Holiday Music
community.description: The study group is slowly convinced to fill in for the Glee Club at Greendale's Christmas pageant.

community.title: Urban Matrimony and the Sandwich Arts
community.description: When Shirley's remarriage to Andre threatens to put her dreams of starting a business with Pierce on hold, Britta steps in.

community.title: Contemporary Impressionists
community.description: The study group must work as celebrity impersonators at a bar mitzvah to pay off Abed's debt to a talent agency owner.

community.title: Digital Exploration of Interior Design (1)
community.description: When Britta falls for the human embodiment of the Subway sandwich chain, Shirley and Pierce hope to use the situation to their advantage.

community.title: Pillows and Blankets (2)
community.description: The students of Greendale are drawn into an epic pillow fight as Troy and Abed start a war that threatens to destroy their unique friendship.

community.title: Origins of Vampire Mythology
community.description: When a carnival comes to Greendale, Annie goes to great lengths to make sure that Britta doesn't contact her carnival worker ex-boyfriend.

community.title: Virtual Systems Analysis
community.description: After sending Troy and Britta on a date, Annie volunteers to keep Abed company in his Dreamatorium.

community.title: Basic Lupine Urology
community.description: When the yam the study group was growing for biology class is killed, Troy and Abed are on the case.

community.title: Course Listing Unavailable
community.description: After a classmate suddenly dies, the study group decides to host a memorial, but Jeff turns his speech into an angry anti-Greendale rant.

community.title: Curriculum Unavailable
community.description: After Abed is caught trespassing at Greendale, he and his friends visit a psychiatrist.

community.title: Digital Estate Planning
community.description: Pierce and his closest friends are summoned to Hawthorne Labs to play a video game that will determine who will inherit his father's fortune.

community.title: The First Chang Dynasty
community.description: The study group stages an elaborate heist to break in to Greendale and free Dean Pelton from the clutches of Chang.

community.title: Introduction to Finality
community.description: Jeff agrees to represent Shirley in a case against Pierce to determine official ownership of their new sandwich shop.

community.title: History 101
community.description: As Jeff competes for spots in an overbooked 'History of Ice Cream' class, Abed copes with the looming end of their time at Greendale by retreating into a surreal mental 'happy place', while Annie and Shirley engage in school-wide pranks.

community.title: Paranormal Parentage
community.description: On the way to a Halloween party, the study group must free Pierce from his panic room and slowly comes to suspect that his mansion is haunted.

community.title: Conventions of Space and Time
community.description: Troy worries about losing Abed to a fellow Inspector Spacetime fan at a convention for the show, while Annie fantasizes about being married to Jeff.

community.title: Alternative History of the German Invasion
community.description: The study group contends with a group of German students who take over the study room. Chang makes his return to campus.

community.title: Cooperative Escapism in Familial Relations
community.description: Britta joins Jeff to see his estranged father on Thanksgiving. Shirley invites the rest of the group to spend the holiday with her judgmental in-laws.

community.title: Advanced Documentary Filmmaking
community.description: Greendale comes together to get to the bottom of Chang's amnesia, which Abed films as a documentary. Jeff, however, suspects Chang is faking it.

community.title: Economics of Marine Biology
community.description: Dean Pelton enlists the study group to beautify the campus to woo a wealthy student to Greendale. A class on teaching P.E. pits Shirley against Troy.

community.title: Herstory of Dance
community.description: Jeff sets out to embarrass Britta when she announces a dance for women's empowerment. Abed dreams of shuttling between two dates in one night.

community.title: Intro to Felt Surrogacy
community.description: Dean Pelton prompts the study group to use puppets to relive the traumatic events of a recent adventure.

community.title: Intro to Knots
community.description: Jeff organizes a lovely holiday gathering at his apartment, but Annie secretly invites Professor Cornwallis to get in his good graces.

community.title: Basic Human Anatomy
community.description: When Annie and Shirley learn that Leonard is actually holding the spot as the class valedictorian, they join forces to bring him down.

community.title: Heroic Origins
community.description: Abed's research into the study group's history uncovers an overlooked series of chance encounters that led each of them to Greendale.

community.title: Advanced Introduction to Finality
community.description: A plan to celebrate Jeff's early graduation is unexpectedly disrupted by the study group's evil doppelgangers from the Darkest Timeline.

community.title: Repilot
community.description: With his law practice doomed, Jeff returns to Greendale to start a class action suit against the school, but a hologram of Pierce has him reconsider.

community.title: Introduction to Teaching
community.description: Abed tackles a two-day crash course on Nicolas Cage, while a clueless Jeff begins his teaching career with Annie as his most demanding student.

community.title: Basic Intergluteal Numismatics
community.description: With the mysterious Ass Crack Bandit back at Greendale, Annie and Jeff are on the case. As clues and suspicions mount, Shirley delivers shocking news.

community.title: Cooperative Polygraphy
community.description: Pierce's funeral leaves the study group with mixed feelings, especially after their late tormentor leaves one last test to reveal everyone's secrets.

community.title: Geothermal Escapism
community.description: For Troy's last day at Greendale, Abed holds a campus-wide "hot lava" fantasy game. With a comic book worth $50,000 as the prize, it's an all-out war.

community.title: Analysis of Cork-Based Networking
community.description: While Annie and Hickey's fight to get a bulletin board repaired spirals out of control, Abed and Britta go to war over spoilers of his favorite show.

community.title: Bondage and Beta Male Sexuality
community.description: Jeff counsels a smitten Duncan on how to get a date with Britta but is developing feelings of his own. An angry Hickey tries to teach Abed a lesson.

community.title: App Development and Condiments
community.description: A new caste system takes over when Greendale beta tests an app that ranks everyone. Shirley loves her new status, but Jeff and Britta want it stopped.

community.title: VCR Maintenance and Educational Publishing
community.description: Abed and Annie try to solve their new roommate dilemma with a retro VCR game, while Jeff, Shirley and Hickey hatch a plan to sell stolen textbooks.

community.title: Advanced Advanced Dungeons & Dragons
community.description: To help Hickey be a more involved grandfather, which means patching up a bad relationship with his son, the gang creates an epic role-playing game.

community.title: G.I. Jeff
community.description: Jeff's depression over turning 40 leads him to drink himself unconscious. In his dreams, he and the gang are part of the "G. I. Joe" cartoon team.
